apps.name: Kazumi-Swift
apps.subtitle: Anime client with custom rules and danmu support
apps.localizedDescription: Kazumi-Swift is an anime collection and online viewing client based on custom rules, featuring danmu support. Developed with native SwiftUI, the interface uses liquid glass material that adapts to system appearance and accessibility settings. It features a built-in mpv playback core with Anime4K real-time super resolution, support for dan dan play danmu, Bangumi tracking binding, schedule, downloads, and WebDAV backup.

apps.name: SealSkin
apps.subtitle: Stream desktop apps from your server to any device
apps.localizedDescription: SealSkin runs desktop applications in isolated containers on a server you control and streams them to any browser or phone. A browser extension turns every link, file, download, and text selection into something you open remotely instead of locally, so nothing from the web ever runs on the device in front of you. With nothing installed, the server's own web app does the same from any browser. It is built on Selkies and the LinuxServer.io application images.

Play with on-screen virtual controls or a supported controller such as a DualSense, Xbox, Backbone, or GameSir. By default, virtual controls stay out of the way while a controller is connected.

apps.localizedDescription:
Zanzibarr turns Usenet into your personal streaming library. Point it at any .nzb and the video starts playing in seconds — no download queue, no waiting for the full file, no disk space sacrificed. Scrub to the final scene of a 4K remux before the first act would have finished downloading. It feels like magic; it's really just a very disciplined engine.

New in v2.0:

• Search everywhere at once — multiple Newznab indexers in parallel, Prowlarr/NZBHydra2 endpoints, automatic Easynews web search and cross-source deduplication.
• Keep the season going — a natural-order play queue, watched-episode badges and a ten-second Up next card with Play now / Finish episode / Clear queue.

• Your accounts and languages, remembered — multiple switchable NNTP profiles, multiple enabled indexer profiles, and preferred audio language carried across episodes.

apps.name: Locus
apps.subtitle: Free open-source iPhone location teleport (MIT)
apps.localizedDescription:
Locus:

Free and open-source iPhone location teleport. Tap the map, search a place, or drive a route — Locus injects coordinates through Apple’s developer location service into locationd, so Maps and other apps see the spoofed GPS (not just a Wi‑Fi lookup that outdoor GPS will overwrite).

Features:

• One-tap teleport (map pin or place search).
• Live joystick — walk / run / cycle / drive with light speed variation.
• Walk/Drive routing on real roads & footpaths (MapKit).
• Draw a path or import / export GPX.
• Background keep-alive + live status bar + drop alerts.
• Favorites & recents.
• First-run setup walkthrough.
• Fully on-device — no analytics, nothing uploaded.

apps.localizedDescription:
Crumb:

Crumb lets you find App Store apps, choose a version and download its IPA on your iPhone or iPad. It runs as a normally sideloaded app, without jailbreak, TrollStore or external JIT.

Features:

• Sign in with your Apple ID and two-factor authentication. Sessions are stored in Keychain; passwords and verification codes are not saved.
• Search by app name, App Store link, app ID or bundle ID, and save favourites.

App availability, licenses and installation remain subject to Apple's account and device restrictions. Browsing another region does not guarantee a download.

App Group decryption:

Crumb attempts on-device decryption using an authorized App Group, without a helper, VPN or pairing. Sign with App Groups enabled in KSign, then choose Decrypt in Downloads. See setup and limitations.

apps.localizedDescription: RyukGram is an enhanced Instagram client for iOS — the full Instagram app with a built-in suite of privacy, logging and customization tweaks. Highlights: follow-request tracking, read receipts, story-viewer insights, deleted-message logs, device-ID masking, media downloading, custom chat themes and a configurable tab bar. Everything runs on-device.

versions.localizedDescription:
# [release] RyukGram v1.6.0

### 🆕 New features

#### Interface & theme

- Theme colors for the whole app or each tab, tab bar color and opacity, keyboard color, and solid or gradient profile backgrounds for you, people you pick or everyone, keeping Instagram's own profile colors by default
- Themes also cover Instagram's own settings pages
- Pick any system or Instagram icon for each tab in Edit tabs
- Story and chat buttons each get one settings page with a live preview, and can move into the story menu or the chat + menu with tap and hold working the same
- Each action button's Configure page can change that button's icon
- Custom fonts in the post and reel text tools, each surface switchable in Theme > Fonts
- Confirm before a status bar tap scrolls to the top or a double tap likes a repost
- Hide Meta AI > Create also hides Restyle in the story editor
- Instagram Plus: bigger message peek sizes, and hold the Instagram logo to pick Plus app icons

#### Feed & filters

- Content filters in General: ads, AI-labeled posts, reels and stories, and hidden words and accounts per surface, with optional per-account lists
- Engagement filters can also hide posts and reels above a like, comment, view or repost count
- Hide music, restyle, trending, suggested reels, suggested accounts, Instants or survey cards between stories, one by one
- Hide the emoji bar above the comment box
- Opening something RyukGram hides tells you why it's missing

#### Reels

- Reel date next to the author, tap for the full date
- Reels limit: always-allowed places like Messages, a custom day start, and a strict mode countdown before RyukGram settings open
- Disable scrolling reels can apply only outside the Reels tab
- Auto scroll can stop at the end of a reel instead of moving on
- Hold Controls can open the playback panel when you hold a reel
- Download every episode of a series from a profile's Series tab

#### Stories

- Hide the comments on stories, and optionally the comment button
- The story action button lists every link in a story, tracking removed, to open, copy or share
- Hold someone in story mentions to open their profile or picture, or copy their username, link, name or ID
- Hold previous or next in the story playback panel to jump to another person
- Meta glasses mode in Stories > Advanced edits story photos and videos with the glasses tools
- Stories archive and the viewer list show each viewer's poll, quiz and slider answer with the results on top, searchable
- Expired stories opened from the Gallery open the highlight they're in

#### Messages

- Keep disappearing messages after they're seen or time out, log them with their media and tag them as Disappeared
- Allow screenshots of disappearing DM photos and videos
- Auto-save photos and videos from people you pick, view-once included, into a Gallery folder per person or Photos, with optional HD
- Unsend several of your messages at once from the Delete for you selection
- Per-chat notifications: deliver quietly, hide the text or the name and text, or set a sound, from the chat + menu or the new Instagram notifications page
- Leave chat after seen returns to the inbox once you mark a chat seen
- Accurate active status lets you pick how often presence refreshes, and offline alerts use the time someone actually left
- Hold the inbox status dot to turn your activity status off for 1 hour, 8 hours or until tomorrow
- Hidden chats stay out of unread badges and DM search, hide again when you choose and can show a hidden icon, and locked chats can show a lock icon
- Hide story rings in the inbox and chat header
- Messages action button can show on normal chat photos and videos

#### Instants

- Confirm Instants capture keeps the exact photo you tapped, lets you watch a video before sending and applies without a restart
- Exclude people from manual seen, or block only the people you pick
- Move to the next Instant after marking one seen

#### Profiles & watchlist

- Profile Analyzer Growth card with a trend line and a full growth page, plus change markers on the header counts
- Deleting a wrong latest scan rolls the analyzer back to the scan before it
- Watchlist saves new notes with the song and clip time, per account or by default, and Media Watch saves new highlight items per highlight
- Watchlist and Visited profiles can be tabs and home shortcuts
- Hide your followers and following lists or yourself from other people's lists, and swap the Message button in your own lists for Following or Remove
- Follow buttons in analyzer lists, the grid feed and follow requests ask first when follow or unfollow confirm is on
- Open link from clipboard also takes usernames

#### Saving & gallery

- Save all can save tagged posts and save straight to Photos
- Download audio from feed, reels, stories and disappearing DM action menus, and Copy media copies the photo or video itself
- Image comments opened full screen get a download button, and comment menus can copy the image or GIF itself
- Lock single Gallery folders with your passcode, hidden everywhere until unlocked
- Gallery settings can show auto-saved DMs in their own folder, with other media or hidden
- Media viewer: Live Text on photos and paused videos, hold a video for 2x, and a menu with speed, save frame, AirPlay and Picture in Picture
- Hold the speed row and slide to fine-tune playback speed in 0.05× steps
- Free crop in the video editor
- Chat background editor previews bubble colors, with their own color, gradient and text color for your messages and theirs

#### Security & privacy

- Everything RyukGram saves is encrypted on the device under unreadable names and stays out of the Files app, existing data and older backups convert automatically
- Lock the stories archive, notification history and follow requests with your passcode

#### Advanced & feature flags

- Instagram files: browse Instagram's own folders, read plists and logs, and import, rename, move or share files and folders
- Storage page shows Instagram's cache next to RyukGram data, with clearing and auto-clear in one place
- Notification check shows whether this install gets full, partial or no notifications and how to fix it
- Disable accounts limit to add more accounts than Instagram allows
- Hold any switch in settings to copy a Shortcuts link that turns it on, off or toggles it
- Instagram API page shows when Instagram asked to slow down and when checks resume
- Tested feature flag presets, one switch each: new home, classic tab bar and inbox, story GIF replies, hold like to react, reels hold menu, comments header, profile reels sorting, keep music playing and more
- Every MobileConfig config and field in Instagram 455 and 456 is named, with the new ones marked

### 🛠 Fixes

#### Instagram compatibility

- Read receipts, the unlocked composer, story buttons, native DM saving, voice message downloads, sticker export, Meta AI menu hiding and keep deleted messages work on Instagram 456
- Reels downloads, expand, carousels and the multi-finger gesture work again on 455 and 456, now with the quality picker
- Reels action button, Picture in Picture, frame grab, like confirmation and tap to mute work again on 455, photo reels and account switches included
- Story playback controls, auto-advance stop, mentions, marking seen and Show quiz answer work again on 455
- Following feed, story tray filters, Stories Archive video detection and hiding feed videos work again on 455
- Home shortcut, DM inbox header buttons and the home refresh and scroll options work on Instagram's new home and inbox
- Follow requests tracking and Confirm follow work again on accounts where they stopped
- Splitting long story videos opens again on the newer story gallery
- Holding the DM inbox title reveals hidden chats when it shows "Messages"
- Compact save sheet works with Instagram's new save sheet
- Confirm Instants capture asks before every photo and video with the new shutter, and No never sends

#### Messages & stories

- Holding a message opens reactions again instead of copying its text
- View-once capture while Instagram is closed works in disappearing chats and with several accounts logged in
- Holding a locked chat no longer previews it
- Selecting messages with Delete for you works with the unlocked composer on
- Chat background colors stay on voice messages while playing and after holding
- Saving a message with several photos or videos goes through RyukGram's save menu, and native saving applies without a restart
- Unsent messages are kept and marked on all your accounts, stay out of your other accounts' chats, and the unsent tag no longer overlaps text or clips on wide media
- Deleting from the deleted messages log also removes the kept message, and the log names 1:1 chats after the other person
- Chats read locally keep the orange eye, and marking a story seen on one account no longer lets your other accounts' views through
- Stories you've seen locally move to the end of the tray
- Story viewer filters search every viewer, and Stories Archive no longer shows 0 viewers on the new story tray
- Mark all in the story seen menu moves on to the next person with Advance on mark seen
- View-once media waits while a menu or share sheet is open
- Story and DM media buttons survive folding an iPhone Duo and act on the right story when stories sit side by side
- Bypass "You can't send messages" keeps the Accept and Decline bar on requests

#### Media & downloads

- HDR gallery videos sent as Instants keep their colors, play smoothly and stop at the end
- Lossless CRF 0 encoding saves again
- Bulk HD downloads no longer crash when they finish
- Holding a profile picture to save it works again on profiles
- Favorite GIFs keep their previews
- Export works on your own cutout stickers and on GIPHY stickers in chats
- Save all shows in the profile menu without the Gallery and saves to Photos then

#### Interface & stability

- Follow status tag gets its own row under the follower counts
- Inbox header buttons no longer cover your username
- RyukGram settings as a tab keep their cards with OLED, and RyukGram screens follow the theme's light or dark choice
- Toasts no longer vanish when the menu that opened them closes
- Instagram Plus fonts show unlocked, and Plus only lists features that work without a subscription
- Reels and story speed applies on every account
- Custom fonts no longer freeze settings or crash story text
- Clearing device data no longer crashes, and cache auto-clear runs once per launch and keeps RyukGram files
- Crash reports skip restarts and app switcher quits, and MobileConfig restarts no longer trip the crash guard
- Reels limit counts every reel, feed reels count toward Feed, and profile reels no longer jump with the session limit
- Switching accounts applies that account's profile, theme, tab bar and Messages-only mode right away, and Messages-only turns on without a restart
- Locked tabs respect Lock every time and stay hidden in the app switcher, and cancelling a lock no longer leaves the app covered
- Spotify and other apps keep playing when Instagram opens
- MobileConfig string and double settings show their real type and apply
- Profile Analyzer paces scans of large accounts
- Declining Confirm follow no longer logs a request
- Hide Meta AI keeps the Drafts tab
- Slovak translation fixes, thanks to @dddaaadddooo

### ⚠️ Known issues

- Unfollow confirmation is missing on profiles in Instagram 446 and later

- Hide hidden chats from the share sheet

- Safari extension — Add an Open in RyukGram banner at the top or bottom, remove Instagram app prompts, block App Store redirects, and optionally open links automatically

- Profile and group pictures remain cached after links expire or caches are cleared, and Refresh Names & Photos updates every screen

- Reels action button downloads photo posts opened from DMs again

- Reels opened from profiles no longer have a stuck comment bar covering the bottom, with a toggle to restore it
- Custom story timestamps appear again on stories nearing expiration
- Story peek no longer closes Instagram
- Links open in the external browser again when that option is enabled
- OLED theme turns search bar backgrounds black and keeps the field inside grey
- OLED theme now covers the story viewers list

- Read notifications work for users with custom settings even when the default Read setting is disabled
- Profile Analyzer now displays every change without truncating usernames, and entries remain visible during refresh
- Follower and following lists show the correct follow status without slowing scrolling
- Following a private account now correctly displays Requested when the action becomes a follow request
- Fake follower, following and post counts work on non-English Instagram and the newer profile header
- Fake counts now apply immediately without restarting Instagram
- No Suggested Users also removes unrelated accounts from the new chat list while preserving contacts and groups

#### Stability & settings

- Fixed inbox loading crashes caused by Keep Deleted Messages writing from multiple threads
- Copying from the share sheet no longer closes Instagram
- Quickly restarting Instagram several times no longer triggers a false crash detection
- MobileConfig overrides are preserved after repeated crashes and disabled instead of being erased
- MobileConfig overrides now apply correctly using the identifier Instagram actually reads
- MobileConfig overrides carry over when updating Instagram versions
- Backup and Restore now lives under Profiles, bringing export, import, reset and storage together
- Follow and unfollow batches now run more slowly, pause automatically when Instagram rate-limits requests, and stop before exceeding safe daily limits

- Custom story fonts display their correct names in the font picker

- Unfollow confirmation is missing on profiles in Instagram 446 and later

- Repost from the gallery: hold any photo, video or GIF and post it as a story, post or reel
- Activity notifications can track only the people in your list
- Hold the story background button to pick any solid color or gradient, with a direction dial

- Sound toggle in the reels and stories playback panels
- Picture in Picture button in the reels playback panel
- Reels auto-scroll moves past sponsored and photo reels
- Post spoofing: pick your own posts and fake their likes, comments, views, shares, reposts and saves, only on your device
- Strip tracking menu: one place for shared and opened links, edit which params get removed, or drop every param a shared link does not need
- Embed domain and tracking param lists support multi-select delete
- Instagram API page in Advanced: reuse recent replies for a set time, pace requests, and cap daily follows and unfollows
- Hide Meta AI now also removes AI images from the gallery picker
- Hide search suggestions: removes suggested accounts and searches from the search tab
- Custom notification sounds: set your own sound for DMs and for other alerts, import from Files, Photos or the gallery and trim it, or use Instagram's own tones
- Opening someone's profile picture now shows every picture on the account, not just the first
- Each active MobileConfig override shows how many times Instagram read it
- Find unnamed MobileConfig entries by the code that reads them, and label them with it
- MobileConfig overrides can be switched off and back on without losing their values, one config or all at once
- MobileConfig params can be filtered to overridden only, or by platform
- Hold any MobileConfig config to give it your own note, shown on the row, inside it, and searchable
- Search MobileConfig by note, param name or id as well as by name and number
- Gallery editing: crop, rotate and resize photos, trim and crop videos, trim audio, pull or strip a video's audio, turn GIFs into videos, then save as new or replace the original

- Redesigned photo crop editor for Draw and chat backgrounds: more ratios, draggable free crop, flip, and zoom out to fit
- Spoofing is now one editor shaped like your profile header, Threads badge included: tap anything to change it, then Apply. A master switch turns it all off, and Edit Profile always shows your real info

- Playback controls in the reels and stories action button, and an auto-advance switch in the story panel

apps.versionDescription:
# [release] RyukGram v1.6.0

### 🆕 New features

#### Interface & theme

- Theme colors for the whole app or each tab, tab bar color and opacity, keyboard color, and solid or gradient profile backgrounds for you, people you pick or everyone, keeping Instagram's own profile colors by default
- Themes also cover Instagram's own settings pages
- Pick any system or Instagram icon for each tab in Edit tabs
- Story and chat buttons each get one settings page with a live preview, and can move into the story menu or the chat + menu with tap and hold working the same
- Each action button's Configure page can change that button's icon
- Custom fonts in the post and reel text tools, each surface switchable in Theme > Fonts
- Confirm before a status bar tap scrolls to the top or a double tap likes a repost
- Hide Meta AI > Create also hides Restyle in the story editor
- Instagram Plus: bigger message peek sizes, and hold the Instagram logo to pick Plus app icons

#### Feed & filters

- Content filters in General: ads, AI-labeled posts, reels and stories, and hidden words and accounts per surface, with optional per-account lists
- Engagement filters can also hide posts and reels above a like, comment, view or repost count
- Hide music, restyle, trending, suggested reels, suggested accounts, Instants or survey cards between stories, one by one
- Hide the emoji bar above the comment box
- Opening something RyukGram hides tells you why it's missing

#### Reels

- Reel date next to the author, tap for the full date
- Reels limit: always-allowed places like Messages, a custom day start, and a strict mode countdown before RyukGram settings open
- Disable scrolling reels can apply only outside the Reels tab
- Auto scroll can stop at the end of a reel instead of moving on
- Hold Controls can open the playback panel when you hold a reel
- Download every episode of a series from a profile's Series tab

#### Stories

- Hide the comments on stories, and optionally the comment button
- The story action button lists every link in a story, tracking removed, to open, copy or share
- Hold someone in story mentions to open their profile or picture, or copy their username, link, name or ID
- Hold previous or next in the story playback panel to jump to another person
- Meta glasses mode in Stories > Advanced edits story photos and videos with the glasses tools
- Stories archive and the viewer list show each viewer's poll, quiz and slider answer with the results on top, searchable
- Expired stories opened from the Gallery open the highlight they're in

#### Messages

- Keep disappearing messages after they're seen or time out, log them with their media and tag them as Disappeared
- Allow screenshots of disappearing DM photos and videos
- Auto-save photos and videos from people you pick, view-once included, into a Gallery folder per person or Photos, with optional HD
- Unsend several of your messages at once from the Delete for you selection
- Per-chat notifications: deliver quietly, hide the text or the name and text, or set a sound, from the chat + menu or the new Instagram notifications page
- Leave chat after seen returns to the inbox once you mark a chat seen
- Accurate active status lets you pick how often presence refreshes, and offline alerts use the time someone actually left
- Hold the inbox status dot to turn your activity status off for 1 hour, 8 hours or until tomorrow
- Hidden chats stay out of unread badges and DM search, hide again when you choose and can show a hidden icon, and locked chats can show a lock icon
- Hide story rings in the inbox and chat header
- Messages action button can show on normal chat photos and videos

#### Instants

- Confirm Instants capture keeps the exact photo you tapped, lets you watch a video before sending and applies without a restart
- Exclude people from manual seen, or block only the people you pick
- Move to the next Instant after marking one seen

#### Profiles & watchlist

- Profile Analyzer Growth card with a trend line and a full growth page, plus change markers on the header counts
- Deleting a wrong latest scan rolls the analyzer back to the scan before it
- Watchlist saves new notes with the song and clip time, per account or by default, and Media Watch saves new highlight items per highlight
- Watchlist and Visited profiles can be tabs and home shortcuts
- Hide your followers and following lists or yourself from other people's lists, and swap the Message button in your own lists for Following or Remove
- Follow buttons in analyzer lists, the grid feed and follow requests ask first when follow or unfollow confirm is on
- Open link from clipboard also takes usernames

#### Saving & gallery

- Save all can save tagged posts and save straight to Photos
- Download audio from feed, reels, stories and disappearing DM action menus, and Copy media copies the photo or video itself
- Image comments opened full screen get a download button, and comment menus can copy the image or GIF itself
- Lock single Gallery folders with your passcode, hidden everywhere until unlocked
- Gallery settings can show auto-saved DMs in their own folder, with other media or hidden
- Media viewer: Live Text on photos and paused videos, hold a video for 2x, and a menu with speed, save frame, AirPlay and Picture in Picture
- Hold the speed row and slide to fine-tune playback speed in 0.05× steps
- Free crop in the video editor
- Chat background editor previews bubble colors, with their own color, gradient and text color for your messages and theirs

#### Security & privacy

- Everything RyukGram saves is encrypted on the device under unreadable names and stays out of the Files app, existing data and older backups convert automatically
- Lock the stories archive, notification history and follow requests with your passcode

#### Advanced & feature flags

- Instagram files: browse Instagram's own folders, read plists and logs, and import, rename, move or share files and folders
- Storage page shows Instagram's cache next to RyukGram data, with clearing and auto-clear in one place
- Notification check shows whether this install gets full, partial or no notifications and how to fix it
- Disable accounts limit to add more accounts than Instagram allows
- Hold any switch in settings to copy a Shortcuts link that turns it on, off or toggles it
- Instagram API page shows when Instagram asked to slow down and when checks resume
- Tested feature flag presets, one switch each: new home, classic tab bar and inbox, story GIF replies, hold like to react, reels hold menu, comments header, profile reels sorting, keep music playing and more
- Every MobileConfig config and field in Instagram 455 and 456 is named, with the new ones marked

### 🛠 Fixes

#### Instagram compatibility

- Read receipts, the unlocked composer, story buttons, native DM saving, voice message downloads, sticker export, Meta AI menu hiding and keep deleted messages work on Instagram 456
- Reels downloads, expand, carousels and the multi-finger gesture work again on 455 and 456, now with the quality picker
- Reels action button, Picture in Picture, frame grab, like confirmation and tap to mute work again on 455, photo reels and account switches included
- Story playback controls, auto-advance stop, mentions, marking seen and Show quiz answer work again on 455
- Following feed, story tray filters, Stories Archive video detection and hiding feed videos work again on 455
- Home shortcut, DM inbox header buttons and the home refresh and scroll options work on Instagram's new home and inbox
- Follow requests tracking and Confirm follow work again on accounts where they stopped
- Splitting long story videos opens again on the newer story gallery
- Holding the DM inbox title reveals hidden chats when it shows "Messages"
- Compact save sheet works with Instagram's new save sheet
- Confirm Instants capture asks before every photo and video with the new shutter, and No never sends

#### Messages & stories

- Holding a message opens reactions again instead of copying its text
- View-once capture while Instagram is closed works in disappearing chats and with several accounts logged in
- Holding a locked chat no longer previews it
- Selecting messages with Delete for you works with the unlocked composer on
- Chat background colors stay on voice messages while playing and after holding
- Saving a message with several photos or videos goes through RyukGram's save menu, and native saving applies without a restart
- Unsent messages are kept and marked on all your accounts, stay out of your other accounts' chats, and the unsent tag no longer overlaps text or clips on wide media
- Deleting from the deleted messages log also removes the kept message, and the log names 1:1 chats after the other person
- Chats read locally keep the orange eye, and marking a story seen on one account no longer lets your other accounts' views through
- Stories you've seen locally move to the end of the tray
- Story viewer filters search every viewer, and Stories Archive no longer shows 0 viewers on the new story tray
- Mark all in the story seen menu moves on to the next person with Advance on mark seen
- View-once media waits while a menu or share sheet is open
- Story and DM media buttons survive folding an iPhone Duo and act on the right story when stories sit side by side
- Bypass "You can't send messages" keeps the Accept and Decline bar on requests

#### Media & downloads

- HDR gallery videos sent as Instants keep their colors, play smoothly and stop at the end
- Lossless CRF 0 encoding saves again
- Bulk HD downloads no longer crash when they finish
- Holding a profile picture to save it works again on profiles
- Favorite GIFs keep their previews
- Export works on your own cutout stickers and on GIPHY stickers in chats
- Save all shows in the profile menu without the Gallery and saves to Photos then

#### Interface & stability

- Follow status tag gets its own row under the follower counts
- Inbox header buttons no longer cover your username
- RyukGram settings as a tab keep their cards with OLED, and RyukGram screens follow the theme's light or dark choice
- Toasts no longer vanish when the menu that opened them closes
- Instagram Plus fonts show unlocked, and Plus only lists features that work without a subscription
- Reels and story speed applies on every account
- Custom fonts no longer freeze settings or crash story text
- Clearing device data no longer crashes, and cache auto-clear runs once per launch and keeps RyukGram files
- Crash reports skip restarts and app switcher quits, and MobileConfig restarts no longer trip the crash guard
- Reels limit counts every reel, feed reels count toward Feed, and profile reels no longer jump with the session limit
- Switching accounts applies that account's profile, theme, tab bar and Messages-only mode right away, and Messages-only turns on without a restart
- Locked tabs respect Lock every time and stay hidden in the app switcher, and cancelling a lock no longer leaves the app covered
- Spotify and other apps keep playing when Instagram opens
- MobileConfig string and double settings show their real type and apply
- Profile Analyzer paces scans of large accounts
- Declining Confirm follow no longer logs a request
- Hide Meta AI keeps the Drafts tab
- Slovak translation fixes, thanks to @dddaaadddooo

### ⚠️ Known issues

- Unfollow confirmation is missing on profiles in Instagram 446 and later

- Copying from the share sheet no longer closes Instagram
- Restarting Instagram quickly a few times no longer counts as a crash
- RyukGram now makes its Instagram requests through Instagram's own networking, so they carry the same identity as the app itself, and spaces them out instead of firing in bursts
- The filter and sort button on follower and following lists no longer hides behind the tab bar
- Custom story fonts now show their own name in the font picker instead of a wrong one
- Fake follower, following and post counts now work when Instagram is not in English, and on the newer profile header layout
- Fake counts take effect right away instead of needing an Instagram restart
- No suggested users now also clears the "More on Instagram" strangers from the new chat list, leaving your own contacts and groups alone
- Works on Instagram 447
- Story peek no longer closes Instagram
- Hiding Meta AI and suggested people on the new chat screen works again
- Custom story timestamps show again on stories that are about to expire
- Sideloaded builds no longer install on iPhones too old to open them
- Links open in your browser again when "Open links in external browser" is on

- Works on Instagram 448
- The message preview row in chats no longer carries a Try Instagram Plus label
- MobileConfig overrides carry over to a new Instagram version instead of silently going blank
- Keep deleted messages, reels playback speed, tap to mute on reels photos and the feed refresh interval override all keep working on Instagram 448
- Save image on stories with music saves the photo again instead of the video
- Save with music no longer fails on some photo posts
- Reels action button downloads photo posts opened from DMs again
- Hiding the reels long-press menu and reels surveys works again on Instagram 448
- Reels auto-scroll no longer skips ahead on the first reel or before the video finishes
- Instants saves and expand now name files after the right person
- Feed action button no longer shows bulk download on single posts or grabs older posts
- Instagram's hold for 2× on reels works again while a custom speed is set

### ⚠️ Known issues
- Reopening the story text tool highlights your last custom font but starts typing in the default one until you tap it again
- Unfollow confirmation does not appear on profiles on Instagram 446 and later

Updated for Instagram 446.0.0.

### ✨ Highlights
- **Setting profiles.** Keep several complete setups under names and switch between them in a tap. Give each one a color and icon, duplicate it, share it as a file, or tie it to an Instagram account so it follows your quick switch
- **MobileConfig browser.** Read and change Instagram's own internal settings from inside the app, with search, copiable details, and export or import of everything you changed
- **Story stats.** Overview numbers over your archive, a views-per-story chart, and a searchable audience list you can filter, sort and pin. Tap anyone to see every story of yours they watched and how they reacted
- **Custom fonts.** Import your own .ttf or .otf files or download from thousands online, then use them across Instagram, RyukGram, or the story text tool
- **Full-resolution photos.** Photos download at their original upload size, often far larger than the copy Instagram hands the app, with a picker showing dimensions, format and file size per option
- **Post and Reel buttons.** Reorder Instagram's own like, comment, share, repost and save buttons, hide any of them, or drop a count without hiding its button
- **View-once media while closed.** Catch disappearing DM media that arrives while Instagram is fully shut, and keep it in the log when it gets unsent
- **Update checker.** RyukGram tells you when a newer release is out, shows what changed, and keeps every past release on its own page under About

### 🆕 New features

#### Setting profiles
- Keep several complete setups under names and switch between them in a tap
- Profiles carry a name, color and icon, and can be duplicated, exported or shared as a file
- Link a profile to Instagram accounts and it switches with the account, with an unlinked profile covering the rest
- Reset a profile to defaults or turn everything off inside it, with a count of what is on and what differs
- Importing a backup can send its settings to a new profile instead of the ones you are using
- Backup & Restore is now Backup & Profiles, with a profile shortcut on the settings home page

#### Fonts and theme
- Import your own .ttf or .otf fonts, or download from thousands online
- Use custom fonts for Instagram, RyukGram, or both, set under Theme
- Your imported and device fonts show up in the story text tool next to the built-in ones
- Manage fonts in bulk from either font picker, with multi-select and a delete confirmation

#### Messages
- Catch view-once media that arrives while Instagram is fully closed and keep it in the log when unsent, off by default, with size and age cleanup
- Logging view-once media you open is now its own switch in the deleted messages log, off by default
- Deleted messages log entries can open the chat and jump to where the message was
- Mark kept unsent messages with a tag, a faded bubble, a tinted bubble or any mix, with your own tag text, position, size and colors
- Confirm before a reaction sends in a chat, catching only the accidental double-tap or every reaction you send
- Hide reels in chats so they never show or open in a thread
- Messages-only mode switches in place with no restart, whether you flip it yourself or the schedule does
- The messages-only schedule can ask first and switch only when you confirm

#### Stories
- Story stats for the archive: overview numbers, a views-per-story chart, and a searchable audience list with filters, sorting and pinned viewers on top
- Story stats compares the last 7 or 30 days against the stretch before it
- Tap someone in the audience list to see every story of yours they watched and what they reacted with
- Refresh names and photos from the story stats screen and any story viewers list
- Playback controls for stories with speed, seek and pause, held from the ⋯ or speaker button or opened from the story menu
- Hold the story eye button to mark a whole reel as seen, or only the stories up to where you are
- Disappearing media has its own settings page, and the mark-as-viewed button only shows when view receipts are blocked
- A slider in the layout editor sets the spacing between story and disappearing media overlay buttons
- Buttons placed next to each other close the gap when one of them is hidden, with a switch to turn it off

#### Feed and reels
- New Post buttons and Reel buttons pages to reorder Instagram's own like, comment, share, repost and save buttons, hide any of them, or drop a count without hiding its button
- Hide metrics and the two hide repost switches moved into those pages, per button instead of all at once, and your old settings carry over
- Tap a reel in the feed to play it in place instead of opening the Reels player, or play first and open on a second tap
- Hold controls for reels: force hold-to-pause, force the options menu, or the options menu with picture in picture
- The reels playback menu gains a pause control
- Expanded view shows the whole reel instead of cropping the sides
- Bring back the old Instagram logo in the feed header
- Status bar tap on the feed can scroll up without refreshing, or be turned off
- Stop the right swipe on the feed from opening the camera
- The doom-scrolling limit can cap the grids on audio, effect, template and remix pages too

#### Profile
- Fake profile options moved to their own page under Profile, with the username, name, counts and badge together
- Fake your own username and display name, shown only on your device
- Follow indicator in follower and following lists, styled separately from the profile one
- Hide the Threads button in the profile header
- Long press a tracked follow request to open the profile, view the picture, filter to that user, copy the username or delete the entry

#### Downloads and gallery
- Photos download at their full upload size, often much larger than the copy Instagram hands the app
- Pick the size a photo downloads at, with the dimensions, format and file size on every option
- Duplicate check asks before you save the same media twice, and can remove the old gallery copy first
- A post or story downloaded to the gallery stays one item you swipe through, with a switch in Gallery settings
- Group any gallery files into an album, or split one back apart, from multi-select
- Saved files share one naming scheme everywhere, stamped with the date the post went up instead of the moment you downloaded it
- Optional ryuk_ prefix on saved file names, under Media saving
- Hold a song in any music picker to download its audio

#### Calls
- Call recordings are tagged auto or manual in the list
- Select recordings to save them to the gallery, share them, share video calls as audio only, or delete them together

#### Interface and general
- Always mute starts feed, reels, stories and DMs silent until you tap a speaker or press volume
- Copied text can open in a sheet first so you can edit it or copy only the part you selected
- Hold any tab in the bottom bar to open a RyukGram screen, picked per tab under Interface, Tab bar, Tab shortcuts, replacing the separate home, search and DM hold toggles
- New MobileConfig browser to read and change Instagram's own internal settings, with search inside a config, copiable details and a home shortcut entry
- MobileConfig changes can be exported and imported from the browser menu
- Auto-clear cache can run on every launch
- Indonesian translation added

#### Updates
- RyukGram tells you when a newer release is out, shows what changed in it, and links straight to the Telegram channel
- New Updates page under About with the update status, what is new in your build, every past release, and switches for the automatic checks
- Tapping the RyukGram name or version on the settings links sheet opens the Updates page

#### Privacy
- Machine ID masking, pinned like the rest of the identifiers, with copy and manual entry
- Mask everything and relaunch rolls every identifier, blocks Apple attestation and clears saved logins in one tap, from Settings or the login screen button

#### Backup
- Backup, restore and storage now list MobileConfig changes and the duplicate download list as their own items
- Restored MobileConfig changes wait until you turn the browser on

### 🛠 Fixes

#### Instagram 443 to 446
- Marking a story seen works again on Instagram 446
- Story text color picker applies your color again on Instagram 446
- Note actions row shows again when you hold a note on Instagram 446
- The icon browser drops the color pet icons Instagram 446 removed, and a button whose icon is gone shows a marker instead of nothing
- Online status updates work again on Instagram 445
- Story mentions button refreshes again when a story opens on Instagram 445
- Story viewer list header buttons are back on Instagram 445, and the reload button works for the first time
- Call buttons hide again on Instagram 444
- Chat backgrounds keep showing after a theme change on Instagram 444
- The old feed logo works again on Instagram 444
- Follow confirmation works again on Instagram 443
- Hiding the reels header works again on Instagram 443
- The icon browser picks up the icons added in Instagram 441
- Instagram Plus story fonts unlock again, and the upgrade prompt stays away
- Instagram Plus story peek now works on DM inbox avatars, not only the stories tray
- Message peek shows the chat, drops the upgrade row from the menu, and opens the chat when you tap it

#### Messages
- Kept unsent messages no longer disappear when a chat reloads its older history, survive a restart, and now cover older messages you never opened
- Unsent messages recovered from an older part of a chat now show who sent them and get logged with their content
- The unsent notification names the chat instead of saying a message was unsent, when the message itself cannot be recovered
- Deleted messages log shows when an old message was originally sent, so it cannot be mistaken for a new one
- A chat no longer shows as read on your other account after a quick switch
- Chats marked seen locally now drop the unread bold on accounts where nothing happened before
- Bubble colors stay on the side you picked instead of leaking onto your own messages
- Gradient bubble colors no longer vanish when you scroll a chat and come back
- Moving between a chat and a reel no longer stacks a second tab bar under the first
- Hiding tabs no longer leaves the tab bar over a reel opened from a chat, or covering the message box on the way back
- Turning on the messages-only schedule asks to restart right away instead of waiting for the window to start
- Your icon order and hidden tabs survive the messages-only switch instead of all coming back

#### Stories and reels
- Opening an archived story no longer wipes its view, like and reaction counts, and counts already flattened are rebuilt from the saved viewers
- Archived story viewers whose profile picture had stopped loading show up again
- The stories archive stops re-fetching viewers for stories that were deleted on Instagram
- The story viewers "Default list" option now shows translated in every language
- Story date format now applies on accounts where Instagram uses a different timestamp style
- Reels no longer crash when scrolling away with the playback toggle on
- Rewinding a reel past its start now jumps to the beginning instead of doing nothing
- Tapping a photo in a reel carousel now mutes it as intended
- Instants no longer crash on a video they cannot read, and say so instead
- The in-call record button now hides with Instagram's own call controls, so tapping to bring them back cannot start a recording
- Calls no longer keep recording into the next call when auto-record is off

#### Downloads and files
- Downloading a video opened from search now saves the video with every quality option, instead of the cover photo
- Downloading a whole post or story keeps its items in the order they were posted
- File names no longer pick up a second extension or timestamp when the same media is saved again
- Sharing from the gallery keeps the name you see in the list instead of a raw id
- Sharing from the expanded view names the file after the account and post date instead of a raw id
- Saved profile pictures keep the quality you see in the preview
- Long pressing an avatar outside a profile page opens and saves it in HD too
- Trimming an HDR video exports instead of failing

#### Feed, profile and interface
- Instagram no longer launches into a tab you hid
- Tab bar buttons now open the tab they show when some tabs are hidden
- The explore grid no longer flashes into view when the explore page opens with it hidden
- The profile action button no longer overlaps the username in the profile top bar
- Fake verified badge stays put instead of vanishing on refresh
- The copy icon is back in the action button menus, Instagram had dropped the artwork it used
- The favorite option on comment GIFs shows its icon properly again
- Color pickers open as a smaller sheet that leaves the page behind it visible
- Confirmation popups no longer let the screen rotate where Instagram itself stays locked
- Long notification text now wraps and grows the pill instead of being cut off, with a limit and an ellipsis
- Link tracking removal strips Instagram's new igsi parameter and works on links using a custom domain
- Shared links now have the same tracking parameters removed as links opened in the browser

#### Privacy and identifiers
- Masked device identifiers now stick: they are written even when Instagram never stored one, re-applied on every launch, and Instagram can no longer swap them back mid-session
- Reverting to your real device ID no longer restores a masked value over it

#### Cache, backup and settings
- Auto-clear cache no longer skips a whole period when a clear fails or gets cut short, it retries until one goes through
- Auto-clear no longer stalls after a clock change or a restored backup
- Clearing the cache by hand no longer pushes the next auto-clear back
- Export and import no longer crash Instagram while scanning what is on the device
- Importing only asks for a restart when what you imported actually needs one
- Settings carried over from an old install no longer come back with the wrong value
- Data saved by older versions no longer crashes the screen that reads it

#### Install, updates and translations
- Changing the app icon now works when Instagram is installed through SideStore or AltStore
- App icon changes that fail now say why instead of showing a bare error
- Installing over the old pre-rename package removes it instead of running both
- The build-from-release workflow names the IPA after the Instagram version you supplied, not the one in the release
- About keeps showing the available version until you update, so dismissing the popup does not lose it
- What's new no longer shows an older release's notes when you are on a build that has not been released yet
- Release notes render properly now, so sub-headings, nested bullets and inline code no longer come through as raw text
- A broken translation falls back to English instead of crashing the screen it is on
- Korean translation reworked to read more naturally
- The Snapshots screen no longer crashes in Japanese, Turkish and Chinese

### ⚠️ Known issues
- Reopening the story text tool highlights your last custom font but starts typing in the default one until you tap it again
- Unfollow confirmation does not appear on profiles on Instagram 446

apps.versionDescription:
# [release] RyukGram v1.6.0

### 🆕 New features

#### Interface & theme

- Theme colors for the whole app or each tab, tab bar color and opacity, keyboard color, and solid or gradient profile backgrounds for you, people you pick or everyone, keeping Instagram's own profile colors by default
- Themes also cover Instagram's own settings pages
- Pick any system or Instagram icon for each tab in Edit tabs
- Story and chat buttons each get one settings page with a live preview, and can move into the story menu or the chat + menu with tap and hold working the same
- Each action button's Configure page can change that button's icon
- Custom fonts in the post and reel text tools, each surface switchable in Theme > Fonts
- Confirm before a status bar tap scrolls to the top or a double tap likes a repost
- Hide Meta AI > Create also hides Restyle in the story editor
- Instagram Plus: bigger message peek sizes, and hold the Instagram logo to pick Plus app icons

#### Feed & filters

- Content filters in General: ads, AI-labeled posts, reels and stories, and hidden words and accounts per surface, with optional per-account lists
- Engagement filters can also hide posts and reels above a like, comment, view or repost count
- Hide music, restyle, trending, suggested reels, suggested accounts, Instants or survey cards between stories, one by one
- Hide the emoji bar above the comment box
- Opening something RyukGram hides tells you why it's missing

#### Reels

- Reel date next to the author, tap for the full date
- Reels limit: always-allowed places like Messages, a custom day start, and a strict mode countdown before RyukGram settings open
- Disable scrolling reels can apply only outside the Reels tab
- Auto scroll can stop at the end of a reel instead of moving on
- Hold Controls can open the playback panel when you hold a reel
- Download every episode of a series from a profile's Series tab

#### Stories

- Hide the comments on stories, and optionally the comment button
- The story action button lists every link in a story, tracking removed, to open, copy or share
- Hold someone in story mentions to open their profile or picture, or copy their username, link, name or ID
- Hold previous or next in the story playback panel to jump to another person
- Meta glasses mode in Stories > Advanced edits story photos and videos with the glasses tools
- Stories archive and the viewer list show each viewer's poll, quiz and slider answer with the results on top, searchable
- Expired stories opened from the Gallery open the highlight they're in

#### Messages

- Keep disappearing messages after they're seen or time out, log them with their media and tag them as Disappeared
- Allow screenshots of disappearing DM photos and videos
- Auto-save photos and videos from people you pick, view-once included, into a Gallery folder per person or Photos, with optional HD
- Unsend several of your messages at once from the Delete for you selection
- Per-chat notifications: deliver quietly, hide the text or the name and text, or set a sound, from the chat + menu or the new Instagram notifications page
- Leave chat after seen returns to the inbox once you mark a chat seen
- Accurate active status lets you pick how often presence refreshes, and offline alerts use the time someone actually left
- Hold the inbox status dot to turn your activity status off for 1 hour, 8 hours or until tomorrow
- Hidden chats stay out of unread badges and DM search, hide again when you choose and can show a hidden icon, and locked chats can show a lock icon
- Hide story rings in the inbox and chat header
- Messages action button can show on normal chat photos and videos

#### Instants

- Confirm Instants capture keeps the exact photo you tapped, lets you watch a video before sending and applies without a restart
- Exclude people from manual seen, or block only the people you pick
- Move to the next Instant after marking one seen

#### Profiles & watchlist

- Profile Analyzer Growth card with a trend line and a full growth page, plus change markers on the header counts
- Deleting a wrong latest scan rolls the analyzer back to the scan before it
- Watchlist saves new notes with the song and clip time, per account or by default, and Media Watch saves new highlight items per highlight
- Watchlist and Visited profiles can be tabs and home shortcuts
- Hide your followers and following lists or yourself from other people's lists, and swap the Message button in your own lists for Following or Remove
- Follow buttons in analyzer lists, the grid feed and follow requests ask first when follow or unfollow confirm is on
- Open link from clipboard also takes usernames

#### Saving & gallery

- Save all can save tagged posts and save straight to Photos
- Download audio from feed, reels, stories and disappearing DM action menus, and Copy media copies the photo or video itself
- Image comments opened full screen get a download button, and comment menus can copy the image or GIF itself
- Lock single Gallery folders with your passcode, hidden everywhere until unlocked
- Gallery settings can show auto-saved DMs in their own folder, with other media or hidden
- Media viewer: Live Text on photos and paused videos, hold a video for 2x, and a menu with speed, save frame, AirPlay and Picture in Picture
- Hold the speed row and slide to fine-tune playback speed in 0.05× steps
- Free crop in the video editor
- Chat background editor previews bubble colors, with their own color, gradient and text color for your messages and theirs

#### Security & privacy

- Everything RyukGram saves is encrypted on the device under unreadable names and stays out of the Files app, existing data and older backups convert automatically
- Lock the stories archive, notification history and follow requests with your passcode

#### Advanced & feature flags

- Instagram files: browse Instagram's own folders, read plists and logs, and import, rename, move or share files and folders
- Storage page shows Instagram's cache next to RyukGram data, with clearing and auto-clear in one place
- Notification check shows whether this install gets full, partial or no notifications and how to fix it
- Disable accounts limit to add more accounts than Instagram allows
- Hold any switch in settings to copy a Shortcuts link that turns it on, off or toggles it
- Instagram API page shows when Instagram asked to slow down and when checks resume
- Tested feature flag presets, one switch each: new home, classic tab bar and inbox, story GIF replies, hold like to react, reels hold menu, comments header, profile reels sorting, keep music playing and more
- Every MobileConfig config and field in Instagram 455 and 456 is named, with the new ones marked

### 🛠 Fixes

#### Instagram compatibility

- Read receipts, the unlocked composer, story buttons, native DM saving, voice message downloads, sticker export, Meta AI menu hiding and keep deleted messages work on Instagram 456
- Reels downloads, expand, carousels and the multi-finger gesture work again on 455 and 456, now with the quality picker
- Reels action button, Picture in Picture, frame grab, like confirmation and tap to mute work again on 455, photo reels and account switches included
- Story playback controls, auto-advance stop, mentions, marking seen and Show quiz answer work again on 455
- Following feed, story tray filters, Stories Archive video detection and hiding feed videos work again on 455
- Home shortcut, DM inbox header buttons and the home refresh and scroll options work on Instagram's new home and inbox
- Follow requests tracking and Confirm follow work again on accounts where they stopped
- Splitting long story videos opens again on the newer story gallery
- Holding the DM inbox title reveals hidden chats when it shows "Messages"
- Compact save sheet works with Instagram's new save sheet
- Confirm Instants capture asks before every photo and video with the new shutter, and No never sends

#### Messages & stories

- Holding a message opens reactions again instead of copying its text
- View-once capture while Instagram is closed works in disappearing chats and with several accounts logged in
- Holding a locked chat no longer previews it
- Selecting messages with Delete for you works with the unlocked composer on
- Chat background colors stay on voice messages while playing and after holding
- Saving a message with several photos or videos goes through RyukGram's save menu, and native saving applies without a restart
- Unsent messages are kept and marked on all your accounts, stay out of your other accounts' chats, and the unsent tag no longer overlaps text or clips on wide media
- Deleting from the deleted messages log also removes the kept message, and the log names 1:1 chats after the other person
- Chats read locally keep the orange eye, and marking a story seen on one account no longer lets your other accounts' views through
- Stories you've seen locally move to the end of the tray
- Story viewer filters search every viewer, and Stories Archive no longer shows 0 viewers on the new story tray
- Mark all in the story seen menu moves on to the next person with Advance on mark seen
- View-once media waits while a menu or share sheet is open
- Story and DM media buttons survive folding an iPhone Duo and act on the right story when stories sit side by side
- Bypass "You can't send messages" keeps the Accept and Decline bar on requests

#### Media & downloads

- HDR gallery videos sent as Instants keep their colors, play smoothly and stop at the end
- Lossless CRF 0 encoding saves again
- Bulk HD downloads no longer crash when they finish
- Holding a profile picture to save it works again on profiles
- Favorite GIFs keep their previews
- Export works on your own cutout stickers and on GIPHY stickers in chats
- Save all shows in the profile menu without the Gallery and saves to Photos then

#### Interface & stability

- Follow status tag gets its own row under the follower counts
- Inbox header buttons no longer cover your username
- RyukGram settings as a tab keep their cards with OLED, and RyukGram screens follow the theme's light or dark choice
- Toasts no longer vanish when the menu that opened them closes
- Instagram Plus fonts show unlocked, and Plus only lists features that work without a subscription
- Reels and story speed applies on every account
- Custom fonts no longer freeze settings or crash story text
- Clearing device data no longer crashes, and cache auto-clear runs once per launch and keeps RyukGram files
- Crash reports skip restarts and app switcher quits, and MobileConfig restarts no longer trip the crash guard
- Reels limit counts every reel, feed reels count toward Feed, and profile reels no longer jump with the session limit
- Switching accounts applies that account's profile, theme, tab bar and Messages-only mode right away, and Messages-only turns on without a restart
- Locked tabs respect Lock every time and stay hidden in the app switcher, and cancelling a lock no longer leaves the app covered
- Spotify and other apps keep playing when Instagram opens
- MobileConfig string and double settings show their real type and apply
- Profile Analyzer paces scans of large accounts
- Declining Confirm follow no longer logs a request
- Hide Meta AI keeps the Drafts tab
- Slovak translation fixes, thanks to @dddaaadddooo

### ⚠️ Known issues

- Unfollow confirmation is missing on profiles in Instagram 446 and later

apps.name: RustRadar
apps.subtitle: Live flight radar on a 3D globe
apps.localizedDescription: RustRadar is a live flight radar on a 3D globe that also displays trains and ships. Written in Rust and drawn with wgpu, the application supports Vulkan, Metal, and DX12 graphics backends. The app renders approximately 20,000 live aircraft worldwide using real shapes based on aircraft types, with about 99.7 percent of traffic resolving to one of 40 specific aircraft models and the remainder using built-in low-poly shapes. Aircraft feature top-down silhouettes, real meshes when tilted, and finer meshes at higher zoom levels. Aircraft are rendered true to scale within sensible on-screen limits and are dead-reckoned between feed refreshes.

apps.name: UTM SE
apps.subtitle: Virtual machines for iOS (without JIT support)
apps.localizedDescription:
UTM is a full featured virtual machine host for iOS. In short, it allows you to run Windows, Android, and more on your iPhone and iPad.
This version runs on all iOS 14+ devices but lacks JIT support and is slower than regular UTM.


More information at https://getutm.app/

Features:

• Emulate any Processor
30+ processors supported by qemu including x86_64, ARM64, and RISC-V
• Run any Operating System
Windows, Linux, and more natively and securely on iOS within an App
• Fast Emulation
Para-virtualization with SPICE and JIT compilation with TCG
• High Compatibility
iOS 14+ supported. Works on iPhone and iPad. No jailbreak needed
• Free and Open Source
UTM and its dependencies are all free and open source
• Easy to Use
Configure and customize your VM in a native UI

versions.localizedDescription:
## Highlights
* (macOS) **DirectX graphics support for Windows**: Modern accelerated graphics for Windows 11 is now available on UTM for the first time. The driver is still experimental and games compatibility is currently limited.
* **Vulkan 1.3 graphics support for Linux**: Vulkan 1.3 is now supported on Linux guests with VirtIO Venus drivers in Mesa. Additionally, OpenGL 4.1 is supported with the new Apple Core OpenGL backend (macOS only).
* **Snapshots**: Save your VM at any point and go back to it later from the new Snapshots tab. Works with QEMU VMs on macOS and iOS 26, and with Apple Virtualization VMs on macOS 27.
* (macOS) **Apple Virtualization on macOS 27**: Pass USB devices through to your VM, turn on Secure Boot for Linux, run a VM without saving changes, and let VMs talk to each other with new networking modes.
* (macOS) **Smoother displays**: VMs now follow your display's refresh rate, so motion is fluid at up to 120 Hz on ProMotion displays.
* **More reliable USB**: Fast external SSDs can now be shared with a VM, and disconnecting a drive no longer freezes UTM. On macOS, drives are safely unmounted before they are handed to a VM.
* (iOS) **Better touch controls**: Gestures respond immediately, with new middle-click and right-drag actions and a new drag-to-scroll touch mode.
* (iOS) **iPhone Duo**: Fold your iPhone Duo like a laptop, and the bottom half becomes a keyboard or touchpad for your VM.

## Notes
* Suspended VMs may not resume correctly after updating. We recommend shutting down all VMs before you update UTM.
* The minimum supported versions are now macOS 12 and iOS 15.
* (macOS) Check out [UTM Games Database](https://db.getutm.app/) to see and report game compatibility for the experimental 3D driver. Re-install the Windows guest tools to get the latest driver.
* We now have a [development blog](https://blog.getutm.app)! Follow us for in-depth technical deep dives such as how we brought DirectX to QEMU.
* (macOS) To use the new graphics driver for Windows 11, we recommend a fresh install because the driver is still experimental and its use could lead to instability in the system. During the install of the guest tools, you will be prompted to select the experimental graphics driver. If you wish to install the new driver on a system that already is running the older display only driver, you need to run the uninstall script provided on the guest tools install ISO first.
* (macOS) Apple CoreGL backend does not support Vulkan or DirectX.
* Linux desktop rendering in Vulkan does not work due to lack of support for indirect draws for geometry shaders. Please configure your guest to use the older VirGL Gallium driver.
* SCSI drives on ARM64 virtual machines now use a VirtIO SCSI controller. A VM with a SCSI drive that was suspended, or has a snapshot with saved state, from an earlier version cannot resume it: delete the saved state and start the VM again.

## Changes (v5.0.9)
* (macOS 14) Display: Reverted the fix for VM windows being limited to 60 fps on ProMotion displays, because it could crash a VM at startup (#8204) and blurred Retina mode (#8191). VM windows still run at 120 Hz on a ProMotion display, unless a slower external display is the main display (added 2026-11-18)
* Fixed Windows games hanging at startup while compiling shaders, in-game videos stalling after the first frame, and a failed 3D command resetting the guest's display (#7984)
* Fixed X11 apps under Xwayland not displaying with Vulkan on Linux
* Updated the virglrenderer, MoltenVK and DXMT graphics backends
* Security: Fixed memory corruption issues that could allow a malicious guest to gain sandboxed code execution in the isolated rendering process (thanks Xusheng Li at Vector 35 Inc)
* Home: VM notes now render Markdown (#3547) (thanks @pingu-the-penguin)
* Home: Fixed the confirmation for Clone, Stop or Move not appearing the second time it was requested for the same VM (thanks @ianplusplus)
* Home: Fixed the screenshot in the VM details being covered by a flat color on iOS 26, macOS 26 and visionOS 26
* Home: The size shown in the VM details now updates after the settings are closed (#7923)
* Home: A VM on an external drive that is listed as unavailable now stays available after its .utm is opened again (#7762)
* Home: Fixed one unreadable saved entry making every VM lose its saved location, window state and external drives
* Config: SCSI drives on ARM64 virtual machines now use a VirtIO SCSI controller, so guests without an LSI driver such as Rocky Linux and RHEL can see them (#7712)
* Config: Fixed PowerPC VMs created with the default settings failing to start because of too many CPU cores
* Config: Fixed the default devices of the Heathrow PowerMac (g3beige) machine keeping the VM from starting (#7803)
* Config: Fixed the default configuration of the Sam460ex machine failing to start (#7603)
* Config: Fixed new PowerPC VMs such as pseries defaulting to a network card that the machine rejects (#7592)
* Config: Fixed saving a VM failing after adding a TPM on RISC-V and LoongArch
* Config: Fixed a crash opening the terminal window of a VM whose configuration has no terminal settings
* Config: Fixed the host port of port forwards being replaced by the guest port when migrating a UTM 3 configuration
* QEMU: Guests with a VirtIO GPU now use the host display's refresh rate instead of always 75 Hz (#7820) (thanks @dragoshont)
* QEMU: Fixed saving a VM state that takes longer than 10 seconds being reported as "Timed out waiting for RPC" (#8052)
* QEMU: Fixed networking and the guest agent stalling once QEMU holds about a thousand open files, such as with a busy shared directory or 3D acceleration (#7624)
* QEMU: Fixed the display modes missing from the Monitors control panel of Mac OS guests on the mac99 machine (thanks @giovariot)
* QEMU: Fixed sound in Mac OS 9 and a hang at startup in its sound driver (#8033)
* QEMU: Fixed Mac OS 9 restarting to a black screen (#7999)
* QEMU: Fixed sound crackling and dropping out while the host is busy
* QEMU: Fixed Windows showing "Display output is not active." for several seconds on every boot with GPU acceleration
* QEMU: Fixed wrong colors in Windows programs that run in exclusive fullscreen with a 10-bit display format
* QEMU: Fixed a newly created VM not writing its debug log until UTM was restarted
* SPICE: Fixed sound staying silent until UTM was restarted after the guest stopped playing audio (#8148)
* CocoaSpice: Fixed a VM restored from a saved state showing a black screen until the guest draws again (#8050)
* CocoaSpice: Fixed a crash when a VM's screenshot was redrawn after the guest changed resolution or the VM stopped (#7745)
* Guest Agent: Fixed a guest being able to crash UTM through the guest agent port (#7684)
* USB: Fixed sharing 10 Gbps (USB 3.2 Gen 2) devices such as external SSDs and NVMe enclosures (#7530) (thanks @giovariot)
* USB: Fixed UTM freezing when a USB 3 drive is disconnected from a running VM (#5851)
* USB: Fixed USB audio devices playing slowly and stuttering (#8028) (thanks @gitwillsky)
* Downloader: Fixed the guest tools never updating after the first download when UTM runs in a language other than English (#7978)
* Downloader: VMs downloaded from a link now show the same warning about custom QEMU arguments as imported VMs (#7733)
* Downloader: Fixed some ZIP files importing as an empty VM
* Shortcuts: Fixed "Pause Virtual Machine" with Save State not saving the state
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS 15) Fixed a crash on launch
* (iOS) Fixed the state saved by "Auto save on background" being lost when iOS ends UTM (#8051)
* (iOS) Home: Fixed a crash when selecting a VM whose configuration failed to load
* (iOS) Home: Fixed the settings closing right away when editing a VM while the list is in edit mode (#7939)
* (iOS SE) QEMU: Fixed wrong results from vector comparisons in guests (#7722)
* (macOS) Fixed a VM never starting, and blocking every later start, when it is started while UTM is hidden (#4091, #7988)
* (macOS) Fixed D3DMetal being selected on Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 27 without Rosetta (#8002) (thanks @pingu-the-penguin)
* (macOS) Fixed Windows 3D acceleration on Intel Macs by no longer selecting D3DMetal there (#8040) (thanks @nightness)
* (macOS) Updated the D3DMetal graphics backend with fixes for corrupted geometry and GPU hangs in games
* (macOS 12) Fixed the Virtual Machine menu having no title in the menu bar (#8117)
* (macOS 14) ~~Display: Fixed VM windows being limited to 60 fps on ProMotion displays when connected to an external display (thanks @dragoshont)~~
* (macOS) Display: Holding a key now repeats it in guests that use a PS/2 keyboard, such as DOS and Windows 98 (#7766)
* (macOS) Display: Fixed clicks from automation, accessibility tools and touch displays landing at the previous pointer position
* (macOS) Toolbar: The USB, drives, shared folder, windows and keyboard shortcut menus now open under their button instead of at the pointer
* (macOS 12) Wizard: Fixed the summary page renaming the library window to "Summary"
* (macOS) Wizard: Going back to the hardware page no longer discards the machine, memory, cores and storage that were chosen
* (macOS 26) Settings: Fixed the Input pane being cut off at both edges of the settings window (#7990, #8022)
* (macOS) Settings: Fixed the Display and Input panes of a VM being cut off in languages with long labels (#7782)
* (macOS) Settings: Fixed number fields with steppers not lining up with the rest of the form (#7702)
* (macOS) Settings: Fixed a click not selecting a port forward (#7600)
* (macOS) Settings: Fixed a crash in the keyboard shortcut editor after deleting a shortcut (thanks @namoen0301)
* (macOS) QEMU: Better performance and steadier sound for x86_64 guests on Intel Macs, with new "Interrupt remapping" and "Lock guest memory" options under QEMU → Tweaks that are on by default (#8046) (thanks @nightness)
* (macOS) QEMU: Fixed GPU-accelerated VMs crashing at startup on Intel Macs (#8036)
* (macOS) QEMU: Fixed multi-core VMs hanging after the guest reboots (#8009)
* (macOS) QEMU: Fixed Windows VMs crashing on reboot or shutdown with the 3D graphics driver (#7981)
* (macOS) SPICE: Fixed a crash while sharing the clipboard with the guest (#8106)
* (macOS) USB: A drive's volumes are now unmounted before it is connected to a VM, which avoids the "Disk Not Ejected Properly" warning (#5650) (thanks @giovariot)
* (macOS) USB: A device set to "Auto connect on start" is now connected again when it is plugged back in while the VM runs (thanks @giovariot)
* (macOS) AVF: Fixed Linux guests having no sound output (#8105)
* (macOS) AVF: Clones now get new MAC addresses when "Regenerate MAC addresses on clone" is on (#7895)
* (macOS) AVF: Say that the disk is full when a macOS install fails because the Mac ran out of space (#7958)
* (macOS) AVF: Side mouse buttons are no longer sent to Linux guests as a middle click (#7739)
* (macOS) AVF: Fixed a crash when taking a screenshot of a VM window with no size (#7650)
* (macOS) Scripting: New `capture screen` and `install guest tools` commands, a `file` property for the location of a VM, and `start … environment` to pass environment variables to QEMU, also as `utmctl start --env` (#5341, #6933)
* (macOS) Scripting: More QEMU options and the sound devices can be set in the configuration, and `guest size` now grows an existing drive
* (macOS) Scripting: The input commands and `capture screen` now work with Apple VMs, and a macOS VM can be created and installed without supplying an IPSW
* (macOS) Scripting: `get configuration` now returns the `source` of each drive (#7743)
* (macOS) Scripting: Suspending with save state now leaves the VM running when its state can't be saved, instead of leaving it paused (#7934)
* (macOS) Scripting: Fixed scripting and utmctl finding no VMs when UTM is launched hidden without its main window (#7949)
* (macOS) Scripting: Fixed a removable drive set from a script on an Apple VM failing on the first start (#8129)
* (macOS) Scripting: Fixed `protocol:TCP` being rejected in a port forward
* (macOS) Scripting: A failed `update configuration` or `duplicate` no longer leaves its unsaved changes behind
* (macOS) utmctl: Commands now exit with a failure status when they fail (#7933)
* (macOS) utmctl: `exec` now waits for the guest process to finish and returns its exit status (#7932)
* (macOS) utmctl: Removed the `attach` command and `start --attach`, which never worked (#7987)

* (macOS) QEMU: Fixed Windows installs from the USB CD drive stalling repeatedly, which made them much slower in v5.0.7 (#7970)

## Changes (v5.0.7)

* ~~QEMU: Windows guests now use the host display's refresh rate instead of always 60 Hz, which also fixes 3D acceleration failing on displays faster than 125 Hz (#7820)~~ This was dropped and will be included in the next update.
* QEMU: Fixed VirtIO GPU stalls that hung Windows at shutdown, stalled 3D benchmarks on Linux, and could leave the Windows 3D driver without a display
* Snapshots: Fixed saving and restoring the state of VMs with compressed disks (#7916)
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS 27.1) Support for iPhone Duo: the VM toolbar sits in the outer display's camera strip, and a new laptop mode turns the bottom half of the folded screen into a keyboard or touchpad
* (macOS) Fixed headless VMs keeping the Mac from sleeping after they were paused or stopped
* (macOS) Closing a VM window or quitting UTM while a VM runs now confirms with "Close" or "Quit" instead of "OK"
* (macOS) Fixed shaders using instancing or integer vertex attributes drawing incorrectly with the Apple Core OpenGL backend (#7944)
* (macOS) Updated the D3DMetal graphics backend with fixes for DirectX 12
* (macOS) Display: The option to use the area beside the camera housing in full screen is now available on macOS 12 and later (#6183)
* (macOS) Wizard: Fixed the Name field's focus ring being clipped on the summary page (thanks @dnicolson)
* (macOS 15) QEMU: Better performance on Apple Silicon with the Hypervisor.framework built-in interrupt controller
* (macOS) Scripting: Force stopping a paused VM is now allowed
* (macOS 27) AVF: Explain when a USB device such as a webcam or phone can't be passed through, instead of showing "VZErrorDomain error -6" (#7914)
* (macOS) Guest Agent: Fixed an issue where clipboard sharing fails upon suspend-resume in macOS guests (you need to re-install the latest guest tools) (#7717)

* Raised the minimum supported versions to macOS 12 and iOS 15 (#7758)

* Updated the KosmicKrisp Vulkan driver, which now requires macOS 26 or iOS 26

* SPICE: Fixed microphone audio quality (#7751)

* CocoaSpice: Fixed typing into the built-in serial terminal (#7814)

* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS) Fixed the VM toolbar and external display on iOS 26 and iOS 27
* (iOS 26) Reclaim Space, Compress, Resize and converting imported drives to qcow2 are now available on iOS (#4774)
* (iOS 27) Confirm before closing the window of a running VM on iPad
* (iOS) Display: Long press and pan gestures respond immediately, touches at the screen edges reach the guest, new middle click and right/middle drag actions, and a new "Touch mode (drag to scroll)" (#4738)
* (iOS) Display: Redesigned the keyboard accessory bar to match the iOS 26 keyboard

* (iOS) Settings: Fixed selecting the KosmicKrisp Vulkan driver
* (macOS) VoiceOver now announces file browse fields by their name (thanks @lprazdnik)
* (macOS) Terminal: Added a find bar (Cmd-F)
* (macOS 27) Display: New option to use the area beside the camera housing in full screen (#6183)
* (macOS 27) Display: Hot Corners are turned off while a VM is in full screen
* (macOS) Settings: Improved the notes field
* (macOS 26) Settings: The "New…" device menu now matches the sidebar
* (macOS) AVF: Sound input and output can be enabled separately, so "Output Only" no longer switches Bluetooth headphones to headset mode (#7875)
* (macOS 26) AVF: New "Shared Network (VM to VM)" and "Host Only" networking modes (#6975, #7480) (thanks @lovon-spec)
* (macOS 27) AVF: USB passthrough, also available from scripting and utmctl (#3778, #7777)
