* (macOS) Scripting: Create and install macOS VMs on the Apple backend (#6092) (thanks @meisenbarth)
* (macOS 27) Scripting: Set up the user account, automatic login and Remote Login of a new macOS VM on first boot (#7757)
* (macOS) Scripting: Fixed shared directories set with `update registry` failing to open on Apple VMs (thanks @atkinsam)
* (macOS) Scripting: Fixed a crash when starting a VM after removing its displays with `update configuration` (#7882)

## Changes (v5.0.5)
* ~~Reverted minimum version requirement imposed by v5.0.4: once again we support versions down to macOS 11.3 and iOS 14.0. However, DirectX support is still limited to macOS 13.0 and iOS 16.0.~~
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* Config: For ARM64 configs, GICv3 is now selected by default. Previously this was only the case for > 8 vCPUs. This improves performance for higher vCPU counts < 8.
* Downloader: Path traversal and symlink checks added when unpacking downloaded ZIP files
* Wizard: scaling is now default to "nearest" when a "classic" computer emulation is created in the wizard and "linear" otherwise. Previously it was "nearest" for all configurations which led to poor scaling filter for anything with higher resolutions.
* (iOS) Support DirectX 11 with DXMT. Note that due to older iOS version (which supports TrollStore + Hypervisor), compatibility of DirectX titles is worse than macOS.

* (macOS) Settings: new options to gracefully power down all running VMs on exit (#7829) (thanks @vectorseven)

* (macOS) Scripting: add snapshots commands to scripting interface (#7832) (thanks @naveenrajm7)
* (macOS) AVF: Better error message when macOS guest version is too high (#7806) (thanks @sigitkusuma)

## Changes (v5.0.4)

* Localization: Updated German (thanks @Benjamin123-tech)
* Scripting: new reload config and VLAN commands (#7710, #7711) (thanks @GregOriol)
* SPICE: Fixed various bugs in renderer that leads to performance and tearing issues

* Updated USB icon (#7718) (thanks @tan9)
* Fixed crash in UTMRegistry and memory leak in AVF installer (#7701) (thanks @Casey)

## Changes (v5.0.3)
* Fixed regression in GRUB rendering time due to new graphics backend
* Fixed Vulkan issues on latest Wayland
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* Home: Confirm delete when using swipe left (#3086)
* Home: Prevent duplicate VMs from appearing (#7533) (thanks @DevSecTim)
* AVF: Fixed CPU spike and mic loss due to two audio devices (thanks @matapo)
* Scripting: Added ability to get IP address from AVF machines (#7643) (thanks @hellcastter)
* Scripting: Fixed "update registry" for AVM backend (#7664) (thanks @EkkoG)
* Scripting: Improve USB device matching logic (thanks @TronickDev)

## Changes (v5.0.2)
* Environment variables are now logged when debug log is enabled
* Fixed a regression in GL acceleration where desktop might not render correctly (#7626)
* Added geometry shaders support to MoltenVK to enable DXVK (thanks @Anducalliew433) (#7575)
* (iOS) Fixed an issue where EAGL backend boots into a black screen (#7587)
* (iOS) Fixed a crash on iOS 15 due to incompatible symbols (#7593)
* (iOS) Fixed verbose logging for graphics backend
* (iOS) Fixed a crash when GL is enabled due to missing support for glDrawElementsInstancedBaseVertex (#7596)
* (macOS) Fixed an issue when after resizing a window if the guest outputs a different resolution size, the wrong texture resolution is used leading to misaligned cursor and warped graphics (#5781)
* (macOS) Fixed an issue where the window resizes to 0x0 when native scaling is enabled

## Changes (v5.0.1)
* CocoaSpice: Reworked Metal renderer to be faster and have lower latency
* Fixed an issue where a BIOS file with a comma in the filename will fail to load
* Default FPS will now be the maximum refresh rate of the display on macOS and iPadOS (iPhone with ProMotion will still have 60Hz as the default rate but can be overridden to 120Hz through settings)
* (macOS) Fixed issue causing `HV_UNSUPPORTED` on startup with Vulkan enabled (#7579)
* (iOS) Fixed resolution issue on external displays (#6040)
* (iOS) Pinch to zoom will turn off automatically updating zoom from the guest (until reset with the resize button)
* (iOS) Fixed external display menu not updating
* (iOS) Fixed incorrect scale on external displays and connecting an external display will now automatically scale to fit
* (iOS) Fixed an issue where powering off the VM will show the home screen but not terminate UTM in the background

## Changes (v5.0.0)
* Add Venus support for Vulkan (#4551)
* Add Apple Core OpenGL support for OpenGL 4.1 (#4285) (thanks @startergo)

## Issues
Please check the full list on [Github](https://github.com/utmapp/UTM/issues) and help report any bug you find that is not listed.

## Installation

* [iOS](https://docs.getutm.app/installation/ios/)
* [macOS](https://docs.getutm.app/installation/macos/)

| File | Description | Installation | JIT | Hypervisor | USB |
|------|------------|--------------|-----|-----------|-----|
| UTM.deb | Jailbroken iOS version | Open in Cydia, dpkg, or Sileo | Yes | Yes(1) | Yes |
| UTM.dmg | macOS version | Mounting and copying UTM.app to /Applications | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| UTM.ipa | Non-jailbroken iOS version (sideloading) | AltStore, etc (see guide) | Yes(2) | No | No |
| UTM-HV.ipa | Non-jailbroken iOS version (TrollStore) | TrollStore | Yes | Yes(1) | Yes |
| UTM-SE.ipa | Non-jailbroken iOS version (sideloading) | AltStore, enterprise signing, etc | No | No | No |
| UTM-Remote.ipa | Remote client | Any | No | No | No |

1. Hypervisor on iOS requires an M1 iPad or newer.
2. Enabling JIT may require a separate JIT enabler such as [Jitterbug][2] or Jitstreamer.

### Verification (macOS)

The macOS release (`UTM.dmg`) is notarized by Apple. To verify the download, run `xcrun stapler validate UTM.dmg`. To verify the install, run `spctl -a -vv /Applications/UTM.app` and check that it is notarized and signed by `Turing Software, LLC (WDNLXAD4W8)`. This needs a network connection, so it cannot run from a sandbox that blocks outgoing connections.

[1]: https://getutm.app/install/
[2]: https://github.com/osy/Jitterbug

## Highlights
* (macOS) **DirectX graphics support for Windows**: Modern accelerated graphics for Windows 11 is now available on UTM for the first time. The driver is still experimental and games compatibility is currently limited.
* **Vulkan 1.3 graphics support for Linux**: Vulkan 1.3 is now supported on Linux guests with VirtIO Venus drivers in Mesa. Additionally, OpenGL 4.1 is supported with the new Apple Core OpenGL backend (macOS only).
* **Snapshots**: Save your VM at any point and go back to it later from the new Snapshots tab. Works with QEMU VMs on macOS and iOS 26, and with Apple Virtualization VMs on macOS 27.
* (macOS) **Apple Virtualization on macOS 27**: Pass USB devices through to your VM, turn on Secure Boot for Linux, run a VM without saving changes, and let VMs talk to each other with new networking modes.
* (macOS) **Smoother displays**: VMs now follow your display's refresh rate, so motion is fluid at up to 120 Hz on ProMotion displays.
* **More reliable USB**: Fast external SSDs can now be shared with a VM, and disconnecting a drive no longer freezes UTM. On macOS, drives are safely unmounted before they are handed to a VM.
* (iOS) **Better touch controls**: Gestures respond immediately, with new middle-click and right-drag actions and a new drag-to-scroll touch mode.
* (iOS) **iPhone Duo**: Fold your iPhone Duo like a laptop, and the bottom half becomes a keyboard or touchpad for your VM.

## Notes
* Suspended VMs may not resume correctly after updating. We recommend shutting down all VMs before you update UTM.
* The minimum supported versions are now macOS 12 and iOS 15.
* (macOS) Check out [UTM Games Database](https://db.getutm.app/) to see and report game compatibility for the experimental 3D driver. Re-install the Windows guest tools to get the latest driver.
* We now have a [development blog](https://blog.getutm.app)! Follow us for in-depth technical deep dives such as how we brought DirectX to QEMU.
* (macOS) To use the new graphics driver for Windows 11, we recommend a fresh install because the driver is still experimental and its use could lead to instability in the system. During the install of the guest tools, you will be prompted to select the experimental graphics driver. If you wish to install the new driver on a system that already is running the older display only driver, you need to run the uninstall script provided on the guest tools install ISO first.
* (macOS) Apple CoreGL backend does not support Vulkan or DirectX.
* Linux desktop rendering in Vulkan does not work due to lack of support for indirect draws for geometry shaders. Please configure your guest to use the older VirGL Gallium driver.
* SCSI drives on ARM64 virtual machines now use a VirtIO SCSI controller. A VM with a SCSI drive that was suspended, or has a snapshot with saved state, from an earlier version cannot resume it: delete the saved state and start the VM again.

* ~~QEMU: Windows guests now use the host display's refresh rate instead of always 60 Hz, which also fixes 3D acceleration failing on displays faster than 125 Hz (#7820)~~ This was dropped and will be included in the next update.
* QEMU: Fixed VirtIO GPU stalls that hung Windows at shutdown, stalled 3D benchmarks on Linux, and could leave the Windows 3D driver without a display
* Snapshots: Fixed saving and restoring the state of VMs with compressed disks (#7916)
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS 27.1) Support for iPhone Duo: the VM toolbar sits in the outer display's camera strip, and a new laptop mode turns the bottom half of the folded screen into a keyboard or touchpad
* (macOS) Fixed headless VMs keeping the Mac from sleeping after they were paused or stopped
* (macOS) Closing a VM window or quitting UTM while a VM runs now confirms with "Close" or "Quit" instead of "OK"
* (macOS) Fixed shaders using instancing or integer vertex attributes drawing incorrectly with the Apple Core OpenGL backend (#7944)
* (macOS) Updated the D3DMetal graphics backend with fixes for DirectX 12
* (macOS) Display: The option to use the area beside the camera housing in full screen is now available on macOS 12 and later (#6183)
* (macOS) Wizard: Fixed the Name field's focus ring being clipped on the summary page (thanks @dnicolson)
* (macOS 15) QEMU: Better performance on Apple Silicon with the Hypervisor.framework built-in interrupt controller
* (macOS) Scripting: Force stopping a paused VM is now allowed
* (macOS 27) AVF: Explain when a USB device such as a webcam or phone can't be passed through, instead of showing "VZErrorDomain error -6" (#7914)
* (macOS) Guest Agent: Fixed an issue where clipboard sharing fails upon suspend-resume in macOS guests (you need to re-install the latest guest tools) (#7717)

## Changes (v5.0.6)
* Raised the minimum supported versions to macOS 12 and iOS 15 (#7758)
* Updated the DXMT and MoltenVK graphics backends
* Updated the KosmicKrisp Vulkan driver, which now requires macOS 26 or iOS 26
* Home: The welcome screen now offers to open an existing VM instead of linking to the gallery
* Snapshots: New Snapshots tab to save, overwrite, restore, rename and delete snapshots of QEMU and Apple VMs. Requires iOS 26 on iOS and macOS 27 for Apple VMs (#5484)
* Settings: Custom QEMU arguments moved to their own page, and the full command line is shown as read-only text that can be copied (#489, #7604)
* SPICE: Fixed microphone audio quality (#7751)
* SPICE: Fixed display and input freezing when audio playback hangs under memory pressure (thanks @evan314159)
* CocoaSpice: Fixed typing into the built-in serial terminal (#7814)
* Terminal: Updated SwiftTerm with a new Metal renderer, and only web links printed by the guest can be opened
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS) Fixed the VM toolbar and external display on iOS 26 and iOS 27
* (iOS 26) Reclaim Space, Compress, Resize and converting imported drives to qcow2 are now available on iOS (#4774)
* (iOS 27) Confirm before closing the window of a running VM on iPad
* (iOS) Display: Long press and pan gestures respond immediately, touches at the screen edges reach the guest, new middle click and right/middle drag actions, and a new "Touch mode (drag to scroll)" (#4738)
* (iOS) Display: Redesigned the keyboard accessory bar to match the iOS 26 keyboard
* (iOS) Input: Game controller Options and Home buttons can now be mapped
* (iOS) Settings: Fixed selecting the KosmicKrisp Vulkan driver
* (macOS) VoiceOver now announces file browse fields by their name (thanks @lprazdnik)
* (macOS) Terminal: Added a find bar (Cmd-F)
* (macOS 27) Display: New option to use the area beside the camera housing in full screen (#6183)
* (macOS 27) Display: Hot Corners are turned off while a VM is in full screen
* (macOS) Settings: Improved the notes field
* (macOS 26) Settings: The "New…" device menu now matches the sidebar
* (macOS) AVF: Sound input and output can be enabled separately, so "Output Only" no longer switches Bluetooth headphones to headset mode (#7875)
* (macOS 26) AVF: New "Shared Network (VM to VM)" and "Host Only" networking modes (#6975, #7480) (thanks @lovon-spec)
* (macOS 27) AVF: USB passthrough, also available from scripting and utmctl (#3778, #7777)
* (macOS 27) AVF: Run without saving changes (#4201, #7326)
* (macOS 27) AVF: Secure Boot option for UEFI guests (#7874)
* (macOS) Scripting: Snapshots are now scriptable objects, and utmctl gains `snapshot` and `discard-state` commands
* (macOS) Scripting: Create and install macOS VMs on the Apple backend (#6092) (thanks @meisenbarth)
* (macOS 27) Scripting: Set up the user account, automatic login and Remote Login of a new macOS VM on first boot (#7757)
* (macOS) Scripting: Fixed shared directories set with `update registry` failing to open on Apple VMs (thanks @atkinsam)
* (macOS) Scripting: Fixed a crash when starting a VM after removing its displays with `update configuration` (#7882)

## Changes (v5.0.5)
* ~~Reverted minimum version requirement imposed by v5.0.4: once again we support versions down to macOS 11.3 and iOS 14.0. However, DirectX support is still limited to macOS 13.0 and iOS 16.0.~~
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* Config: For ARM64 configs, GICv3 is now selected by default. Previously this was only the case for > 8 vCPUs. This improves performance for higher vCPU counts < 8.
* Downloader: Path traversal and symlink checks added when unpacking downloaded ZIP files
* Wizard: scaling is now default to "nearest" when a "classic" computer emulation is created in the wizard and "linear" otherwise. Previously it was "nearest" for all configurations which led to poor scaling filter for anything with higher resolutions.
* (iOS) Support DirectX 11 with DXMT. Note that due to older iOS version (which supports TrollStore + Hypervisor), compatibility of DirectX titles is worse than macOS.
* (iOS) QEMU: Fixed MMIO BAR bug which prevented large hostmem window from working
* (iOS) Config: Improved RAM limit detection
* (macOS) DirectX 12 is now supported with D3DMetal backend (when available). You must (re)install the latest UTM guest tools experimental 3D graphics driver.
* (macOS) Support holding down Caps Lock key when input capture is enabled (#7840) (thanks @lprazdnik)
* (macOS) Settings: new options to gracefully power down all running VMs on exit (#7829) (thanks @vectorseven)
* (macOS) Settings: support Cmd<->Opt swapping (#7837) (thanks @lprazdnik)
* (macOS) Scripting: add snapshots commands to scripting interface (#7832) (thanks @naveenrajm7)
* (macOS) AVF: Better error message when macOS guest version is too high (#7806) (thanks @sigitkusuma)

## Changes (v5.0.4)
* (macOS) Added support for Neptune backend in virglrenderer for DirectX support
* Localization: Updated German (thanks @Benjamin123-tech)
* Scripting: new reload config and VLAN commands (#7710, #7711) (thanks @GregOriol)
* SPICE: Fixed various bugs in renderer that leads to performance and tearing issues
* SPICE: Fixed a memory leak that could result in large amount of memory use by UTM
* Updated USB icon (#7718) (thanks @tan9)
* Fixed crash in UTMRegistry and memory leak in AVF installer (#7701) (thanks @Casey)

## Changes (v5.0.3)
* Fixed regression in GRUB rendering time due to new graphics backend
* Fixed Vulkan issues on latest Wayland
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* Home: Confirm delete when using swipe left (#3086)
* Home: Prevent duplicate VMs from appearing (#7533) (thanks @DevSecTim)
* AVF: Fixed CPU spike and mic loss due to two audio devices (thanks @matapo)
* Scripting: Added ability to get IP address from AVF machines (#7643) (thanks @hellcastter)
* Scripting: Fixed "update registry" for AVM backend (#7664) (thanks @EkkoG)
* Scripting: Improve USB device matching logic (thanks @TronickDev)

## Changes (v5.0.2)
* Environment variables are now logged when debug log is enabled
* Fixed a regression in GL acceleration where desktop might not render correctly (#7626)
* Added geometry shaders support to MoltenVK to enable DXVK (thanks @Anducalliew433) (#7575)
* (iOS) Fixed an issue where EAGL backend boots into a black screen (#7587)
* (iOS) Fixed a crash on iOS 15 due to incompatible symbols (#7593)
* (iOS) Fixed verbose logging for graphics backend
* (iOS) Fixed a crash when GL is enabled due to missing support for glDrawElementsInstancedBaseVertex (#7596)
* (macOS) Fixed an issue when after resizing a window if the guest outputs a different resolution size, the wrong texture resolution is used leading to misaligned cursor and warped graphics (#5781)
* (macOS) Fixed an issue where the window resizes to 0x0 when native scaling is enabled

## Changes (v5.0.1)
* CocoaSpice: Reworked Metal renderer to be faster and have lower latency
* Fixed an issue where a BIOS file with a comma in the filename will fail to load
* Default FPS will now be the maximum refresh rate of the display on macOS and iPadOS (iPhone with ProMotion will still have 60Hz as the default rate but can be overridden to 120Hz through settings)
* (macOS) Fixed issue causing `HV_UNSUPPORTED` on startup with Vulkan enabled (#7579)
* (iOS) Fixed resolution issue on external displays (#6040)
* (iOS) Pinch to zoom will turn off automatically updating zoom from the guest (until reset with the resize button)
* (iOS) Fixed external display menu not updating
* (iOS) Fixed incorrect scale on external displays and connecting an external display will now automatically scale to fit
* (iOS) Fixed an issue where powering off the VM will show the home screen but not terminate UTM in the background

## Changes (v5.0.0)
* Add Venus support for Vulkan (#4551)
* Add Apple Core OpenGL support for OpenGL 4.1 (#4285) (thanks @startergo)

Please check the full list on [Github](https://github.com/utmapp/UTM/issues) and help report any bug you find that is not listed.

## Installation

* [iOS](https://docs.getutm.app/installation/ios/)
* [macOS](https://docs.getutm.app/installation/macos/)

| File | Description | Installation | JIT | Hypervisor | USB |
|------|------------|--------------|-----|-----------|-----|
| UTM.deb | Jailbroken iOS version | Open in Cydia, dpkg, or Sileo | Yes | Yes(1) | Yes |
| UTM.dmg | macOS version | Mounting and copying UTM.app to /Applications | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| UTM.ipa | Non-jailbroken iOS version (sideloading) | AltStore, etc (see guide) | Yes(2) | No | No |
| UTM-HV.ipa | Non-jailbroken iOS version (TrollStore) | TrollStore | Yes | Yes(1) | Yes |
| UTM-SE.ipa | Non-jailbroken iOS version (sideloading) | AltStore, enterprise signing, etc | No | No | No |
| UTM-Remote.ipa | Remote client | Any | No | No | No |

1. Hypervisor on iOS requires an M1 iPad or newer.
2. Enabling JIT may require a separate JIT enabler such as [Jitterbug][2] or Jitstreamer.

### Verification (macOS)

The macOS release (`UTM.dmg`) is notarized by Apple. To verify the download, run `xcrun stapler validate UTM.dmg`. To verify the install, run `spctl -a -vv /Applications/UTM.app` and check that it is notarized and signed by `Turing Software, LLC (WDNLXAD4W8)`. This needs a network connection, so it cannot run from a sandbox that blocks outgoing connections.

[1]: https://getutm.app/install/
[2]: https://github.com/osy/Jitterbug

apps.subtitle: Gecko-based browser with Firefox add‑on support
apps.localizedDescription: Reynard is a Gecko-based web browser for iOS 13 and later. Unlike other iOS browsers that must use Apple's WebKit engine, Reynard uses the same Gecko engine that powers Firefox on desktop and Android. It supports Firefox add‑ons, including more capable ad‑blocking extensions, and provides privacy features such as Enhanced Tracking Protection and DNS over HTTPS. The app works on iOS 14 and the latest iOS versions.

apps.name: Twitch
apps.subtitle: A better Twitch experience for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
TwitchPlusK is a tweak for the official Twitch iOS app. It keeps the native app and adds a fully customizable chat, 7TV/BTTV/FFZ emotes, adblock, Channel Points Auto Claim, OLED mode and more.

Available in ENGLISH and FRENCH from the Settings menu.

Chat and emotes:

• Reveal deleted messages and view timeout durations or permanent ban labels.
• Access 7TV, BTTV, and FFZ emotes through a dedicated emote picker.
• Search emotes, manage favorites, and import favorites from PC.

Ad blocking:

• Proxy — block stream ads through a default or custom proxy.
• Local (VAFT) — block stream ads without a video proxy.
• Proxy + Local (VAFT) — combine a stream relay with local ad blocking.
• Use a separate emote proxy on networks that block emote services.

apps.localizedDescription: Maestro Mobile is an iOS companion for Pi. Sessions run on your computer while the app connects through a local host service to show progress and control authorized live sessions. Browse sessions, search history, and inspect real-time usage, active tasks, teammates, and execution progress. apps.name: Tolkara
apps.subtitle: Run unmodified macOS apps on iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Tolkara runs unmodified arm64 macOS applications on an iPad, with experimental iPhone support. It loads the original executable as data, executes its instructions natively on the device's Apple silicon, and translates the macOS API calls it makes such as AppKit, Metal, CoreAudio, Carbon, and Security into their iOS and iPadOS equivalents.

It follows the model of Wine and Valve's Proton. The program is not ported or patched, and its executable is never modified or re-signed. Only the operating-system calls underneath it are translated, leaving the application's code, logic, assets, and network protocol exactly as the vendor shipped them.

1.) Open SoundCloud
2.) Press and hold the Home button on the bottom-left corner of the tab bar

4.) Toggle on: Unlock Plus Subscription, Download Songs
5.) Tap the checkmark ✔️ icon on the top-right corner and click Restart Now

Steps to Download Songs:

1.) Play any song
2.) Tap the orange 🟠 Download icon ⬇️ to download the song
3.) Swipe down to exit the song
4.) Press and hold the Home button on the bottom-left corner of the tab bar
5.) Tap the downloaded song to play it
6.) Swipe down to exit the song
7.) Swipe from right-to-left on the downloaded song you want to export
8.) Tap Save to Files, choose where you want to save the song, then tap Save

apps.name: PeonPad
apps.subtitle: Warcraft II port for iPad
apps.localizedDescription: PeonPad is an independent Apple-platform port of Warcraft II built on the open-source Stratagus engine and Wargus game layer. It runs engine code directly on iPadOS without using a Windows executable, x86 emulation, or remote streaming. The app does not include any game data; you must supply data extracted from your own legally owned copy of Warcraft II on a Mac or PC. That data remains on your device and is not bundled with the download. The project uses substantial AI assistance for code, tests, documentation, debugging, and maintenance, and some support replies are automated. Build, test, and device records describe what was verified.

File import happens locally, and VaultPad does not download or upload your game files. VaultPad uses substantial AI assistance for code, tests, documentation, debugging, and maintenance, with some automated support replies and maintenance tasks. Build, test, and device records describe what was checked.

apps.name: RAtouch
apps.subtitle: Play Red Alert on touch devices
apps.localizedDescription: RAtouch brings the original Red Alert engine to Apple platforms with touch controls designed for real-time strategy gameplay. Tap to select or issue orders, drag to select with one finger, pan the map with two fingers, and pinch to zoom. A hold acts as a right-click, while a native command deck provides keyboard actions and control groups. Campaigns, skirmish AI, movies, music, saves, and simulation rules remain intact. This app does not include commercial game data; you must provide compatible files.

apps.subtitle: Bring Pharaoh and Cleopatra to Apple devices
apps.localizedDescription: Emerald Tablet brings the original 1999 Pharaoh and Cleopatra to Apple devices using the open-source Akhenaten engine. Designed primarily for landscape iPadOS, it features touch navigation, Apple Pencil construction, crisp scaling, native game-speed controls, and a small persistent controls menu. The application also supports iPhone and Apple Silicon Mac. This release contains the Apple integration, patch queue, tests, and build scripts. It does not include Pharaoh, Cleopatra, saved games, or original game data. Users must supply their own legally obtained compatible files.

It is not an emulator, streamed desktop session, or repackaged copy. Requires a Mac with Xcode, CMake 3.21 or newer, Git, an Apple ID configured for development signing, and a paired iPad with Developer Mode enabled. apps.name: DaggerPad
apps.subtitle: Play Daggerfall Unity natively on iPadOS
apps.localizedDescription: DaggerPad brings Daggerfall Unity as a native iPadOS app. It features native landscape gameplay, contextual controls, and the original Daggerfall world. Built with Metal rendering, it imports classic Daggerfall files through the Files app and includes a landscape touch interface designed for movement, looking, combat, conversations, inventory, and the original game dense user interface. The mobile baseline originates from Vwing Daggerfall Unity Android fork with iPadOS integration, native pointer input, Files import, lifecycle handling, and DaggerPad touch layouts. Note that it does not contain Daggerfall, Bethesda game data, or a prepared playable archive.

apps.localizedDescription: XeniOS is an experimental Apple-focused fork of Xenia, currently based on Xenia Edge. It serves as a fast-moving place to develop, test, and ship iOS and macOS work while carrying platform changes that benefit ARM64 Windows, Linux, and Android. apps.localizedDescription: Ozen converts spoken words into large, steady captions on your phone as people speak. Words stay in place on screen and identify who is speaking. apps.name: ChopPad
apps.subtitle: Hardware-style pad sampler for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: ChopPad is a pad sampler for iPhone and iPad with a hardware-inspired layout: one screen with keys, knobs, a data wheel, a fader, and 16 square pads across 8 banks. apps.name: Screen Stream
apps.subtitle: Control iOS devices and simulators over a JSON-RPC API
apps.localizedDescription: Control any iOS device or simulator over a simple JSON-RPC API. Tap, swipe, stream video, and inspect the UI from any language over localhost. Build interactive automation with tap, swipe, long-press, text typing, and hardware button controls. Launch, terminate, and detect foreground apps by bundle ID. Stream live video via MJPEG and H264 with configurable FPS, bitrate, and quality. Inspect the UI with full accessibility tree dumps, capture PNG or JPEG screenshots, control system orientation, open URLs, and query screen size. Broadcast audio and video using ReplayKit over TCP with flexible transport options over WebSocket or HTTP.

apps.name: EhPanda
apps.subtitle: The E-Hentai app crafted exclusively for iPhone and iPad.
apps.localizedDescription:
EhPanda is a free, open-source app for E-Hentai on iPhone and iPad.

Search by category, rating, tag or page count, and save the searches you use often. Open a gallery to see its tags, rating, previews and comments, and find similar ones.

Read by scrolling or turning pages, one or two pages at a time, with zoom, auto-play and Live Text translation. Download galleries to read offline, even in the background.

Sign in to use your favorites and watched tags. Toplists, tag translation, Hath archives and torrents are there too. If your network blocks E-Hentai, one switch in Settings gets you through.

EhPanda is not affiliated with or endorsed by E-Hentai.

versions.localizedDescription:
EhPanda 3.0 is rebuilt with a new look.

Download galleries to read offline, sort them into folders, and keep downloading in the background.

Jump to galleries around any date with Seek to Date.

Log in with your username and password again, even behind a Cloudflare check.

Report comments, see a warning before posting, and block users.

Larger text, VoiceOver and Voice Control now work across the app.

Every screen rotates with your device, so the Enables landscape setting is gone.

The Auto-Lock setting is gone. To lock EhPanda, touch and hold its icon, then choose Require Face ID or Require Touch ID.

On first launch, you confirm you're an adult and choose how much anonymous usage data to share.

Plus WebP images and many fixes.

https://ehpanda.app

apps.name: Kant
apps.subtitle: Secure and open-source messenger
apps.localizedDescription: Kant is a free, open-source messenger that requires no phone number or email address. Messages are encrypted on your device and decrypted only on the devices of your recipients, with no company server storing copies. A relay passes encrypted messages between devices behind routers, mobile data, and firewalls without being able to read or store them. Anyone can run a relay on a server, home computer, or inside the Kant desktop app. The app is in public beta and has not undergone an independent security audit.

apps.name: Unbill
apps.subtitle: Peer-to-peer shared expense ledgers
apps.localizedDescription: Unbill keeps shared expense ledgers on member devices and syncs them peer-to-peer. There is no hosted source of truth, hosted account system, or telemetry surface. The app records who paid and who owes whom. It does not move money. Unbill is meant for households, trips, couples, and other small groups that already trust each other. It is not a payment network, bank integration layer, general accounting package, or product for hostile or anonymous groups. Your data stays on your devices. Ledgers sync directly between group members without a cloud account required. It works offline to record expenses without a network and merges changes automatically when devices reconnect.

apps.subtitle: Video editor
apps.localizedDescription:
CapCut offers easy-to-use video editing functions, in-APP fonts and effects, advanced features such as keyframe animation, smooth slow-motion, chroma key, and stabilization, to help you capture and snip moments.

Create fancy videos with other unique features: auto captions, text-to-speech, motion tracking, and background removal. Show your personality and go viral on TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Facebook!

FEATURES
Basic video editing
• Trim and shorten clips and split or merge videos.
• Adjust video speed from 0.1x to 100x, and apply speed curves to clips.
• Animate video clips with incredible zoom in/out effects.
• Highlight the best moments with the freeze feature.
• Explore transition options with awesome effects on and between clips.

Advanced video editor
• Keyframe video animation is available for all settings.
• Edit videos to create smooth slow-motion with the optical flow feature and speed curve tool.
• Use the chroma key to remove specific colors from videos.
• Easy to arrange and preview clips on multi-track timeline.
• The stabilizing feature keeps video footage steady.

Intelligent features
• Auto captions: automate speech recognition and subtitles in videos.
• Text-to-speech: apply text-to-speech in multiple languages and voices.
• Background removal: automatically remove backgrounds.

Text & Stickers
• Add text to videos with different fonts and styles, choose unique text templates. Fonts can be imported locally.
• Subtitles can be added to the timeline of video tracks and can be moved and adjusted in one step.

Trending Effects & Filters
• Match video content with diverse filters that are updated weekly with the latest trends.
• Edit videos with hundreds of trending effects, including Glitch, Blur, 3D, etc.
• Add movie-style video filters or adjust video brightness, contrast, etc.

Music & Sound Effects
• Add millions of music clips and sound effects to videos.
• Extract audio, clips, and recordings from videos.

Easy to Share
• Custom video export resolution, HD video editor supports 4K 60fps exports and smart HDR.
• Adjust the format and share with your friends on social media platforms.

Built with React and Rust, this client offers native performance and a lightweight architecture for efficient use.

apps.name: Delta
apps.subtitle: Classic games in your pocket.
apps.localizedDescription:
Delta is an all-in-one emulator for iOS and iPadOS. Delta builds upon the strengths of its predecessor, GBA4iOS, while expanding to include support for more game systems such as NES, SNES, N64, Nintendo DS, and Sega Genesis.

FEATURES

Supported Game Systems
• Nintendo Entertainment System
• Super Nintendo Entertainment System
• Nintendo 64
• Game Boy (Color)
• Game Boy Advance
• Nintendo DS
• Sega Genesis

Online Multiplayer
• Play online-compatible Nintendo DS games with friends around the world!
• Connect via community Nintendo WFC servers.
• Choose one of the default servers, or provide a custom DNS.

Controller Support
• Nintendo Switch Pro controllers, Joy-Cons
• Nintendo Switch Online controllers (NES, SNES, N64)
• PS4, PS5
• Xbox One S, Xbox Series X
• MFi game controllers
• Bluetooth & wired keyboards

RetroAchievements
• Sign in with your RetroAchievements account to earn achievements in any supported game.
• Supports Hardcore mode, which disables loading save states and using cheats.
• Shows your achievement progress when launching a game.

Save States
• Save and load save states for any game from the pause menu.
• Lock save states to prevent them from being accidentally overwritten.
• Automatically makes backup save states to ensure you never lose your progress.
• Support for “Quick Saves,” save states that can be quickly saved/loaded with a single button press (requires external controller).

Cheats
• Supports various types of cheat codes for each supported system:
• NES: Game Genie
• SNES: Game Genie, Pro Action Replay
• N64: GameShark
• GBC: Game Genie, GameShark
• GBA: Action Replay, Code Breaker, GameShark
• DS: Action Replay
• Genesis: Action Replay, Game Genie

Delta Sync
• Sync your games, game saves, save states, cheats, controller skins, and controller mappings between devices.
• View version histories of everything you sync and optionally restore them to earlier versions.
• Supports both Google Drive and Dropbox.

Custom Controller Skins
• Beautiful built-in controller skins for all systems.
• Import controller skins made by others, or even make your own to share with the world!
• Supports animated buttons for even more immersion when playing games.

Hold Button
• Choose buttons for Delta to hold down on your behalf, freeing up your thumbs to press other buttons instead.
• Perfect for games that typically require one button be held down constantly (ex: run button in Mario games, or the A button in Mario Kart).

Fast Forward
• Speed through slower parts of games by running the game much faster than normal.
• Easily enable or disable from the pause menu, or optionally with a mapped button on an external controller.
• Customize speed per-game by long-pressing Fast Forward option in pause menu.

3D/Haptic Touch
• Use 3D or Haptic Touch to “peek” at games, save states, and cheat codes.
• App icon shortcuts allow quick access to your most recently played games, or optionally customize the shortcuts to always include certain games.

Game Artwork
• Automatically displays appropriate box art for imported games.
• Change a game’s artwork to anything you want, or select from the built-in game artwork database.

Misc.
• Gyroscope support (WarioWare: Twisted! only)
• Microphone support (DS only)
• Support for delta:// URL scheme to jump directly into a specific game.

Delta Terms of Use: https://altstore.io/terms

**Delta is in no way affiliated with Nintendo or Sega. The name “Nintendo” and all associated game console names are registered trademarks of Nintendo Co., Ltd. The name “Sega” and all associated game console names are registered trademarks of Sega Corporation.**

Sega Genesis

Liquid Glass UI

RetroAchievements
• Sign in with your RetroAchievements account to earn achievements in any supported game

Recents & Favorites

apps.localizedDescription: Keka is a full featured file archiver that lets you compress files into multiple formats and encrypt them for secure sharing and privacy. It allows you to browse and extract a wide range of compressed files, including ZIP, 7Z, and RAR archives, even when they are encrypted or use older charsets. Supported compression formats include 7Z, ZIP, TAR, ZSTD, GZIP, BZIP2, and AppleArchive. Supported extraction formats include 7Z, ZIP, RAR, TAR, GZIP, BZIP2, AAR, XZ, ZSTD, ISO, LZMA, EXE, CAB, MSI, PAX, JAR, APK, APPX, XPI, IPA, CPGZ, CPIO, XIP, CPT, and others.

apps.name: pziOS
apps.subtitle: Run Project Zomboid on your iPhone or iPad
apps.localizedDescription: pziOS runs Project Zomboid Build 42 on an iPhone or iPad. It functions as a launcher and includes the runtime required for the game, featuring a Java virtual machine built for iOS, an OpenGL-to-Metal graphics stack, and audio and input layers. The app runs your own copy of the game, as no game assets are included or downloaded. Users must own Project Zomboid separately. This free and non-commercial project is not for sale, not for profit, and not affiliated with or endorsed by The Indie Stone. This is a beta release tested on specific devices, so expect rough performance.

apps.localizedDescription: SymbOS runs Symbian^3 and Belle apps on iPhone, iPad and Mac from a home screen that looks and works like the iPhone. Tap the plus button to install a sis or sisx file and it lands on the home screen next to your phone apps. Put any Symbian app on the real iPhone home screen or in the Mac Applications folder and Dock. Tapping it opens straight into that app, the way Parallels runs Windows apps on a Mac. SymbOS is built on the open-source EKA2L1 emulator and its iOS port.

apps.name: Notes:
apps.subtitle: Apple Notes meets GitHub for local-first notes
apps.localizedDescription: Apple Notes meets GitHub. A native SwiftUI iPhone app for local-first notes that can be linked to files in GitHub repositories, with real commits, history, diffs, offline editing and conflict resolution. Requires iOS 26 and newer, and targets iOS 27 automatically once the build machine has the iOS 27 SDK. The source was written without access to Xcode, so it has not yet been compiled or run on a device. The first CI run on a macOS runner is the first real build. The bundle is always named nbwsc-vX.Y.Z.ipa plus a sha256. Compute the next version from the latest vX.Y.Z tag, run unit tests, and archive the app to package an ipa.

apps.localizedDescription: Cresca is a free music player powered by live YouTube data. Search millions of songs, stream instantly, sing along with synced karaoke lyrics, build playlists, download for offline listening, and sign in with your YouTube session. Everything stays on your device with no account, no analytics, and no server. Enjoy real YouTube audio with search plus signature deciphered streams, gapless queue playback, smart shuffle, repeat, and a multi gigabyte predictive cache for instant skips. The vibe queue matches the Up Next list to the song mood through YouTube related data, filtering out same name clones, one singer loops, mixes, and hour long uploads.

apps.name: gase
apps.subtitle: Sega Mega Drive and Genesis emulator written in Rust
apps.localizedDescription: gase is a Sega Mega Drive and Genesis emulator built in Rust. Designed for learning and performance, every hardware chip lives in its own documented crate, and the emulator core has no external dependencies. It aims to be fast, highly compatible, and pleasant to use. The project documents its own development process chip by chip, and the emulator also runs directly in your web browser.

apps.localizedDescription: SEGA Superstars Tennis ported to iPhone and iPad by statically recompiling the original PowerPC code to arm64 using ReXGlue. Graphics run through Vulkan on Metal via MoltenVK. Requires your own Xbox 360 game copy; assets not included. Loads Xbox 360 ISO/XISO directly or extracted files. Runs up to 60 FPS on recent iPhones. Supports on-screen touch controls and MFi, Xbox, PlayStation controllers.

apps.name: Just Volleyball
apps.subtitle: Volleyball game built with Godot for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: Just Volleyball is an iOS game built as a Godot project. It runs in landscape orientation on iPhone and iPad with iOS 15 or later. The game requires a device with an A12 chip or newer, such as the iPhone XS, iPhone XR, and later models, or any current iPad, due to Godot Metal renderer requirements. The project includes a GitHub Actions pipeline that generates an unsigned IPA file on macOS runners, allowing you to obtain the build without needing a Mac or an Apple Developer account, provided you use an Apple ID to sign it upon installation.

apps.name: KittenTTS
apps.subtitle: Offline text-to-speech with voice cloning
apps.localizedDescription:
KittenTTS is an offline text-to-speech app for iPhone and iPad. Speech generation runs entirely on your device after downloading a model, requiring no account or cloud service.

KittenTTS 2 offers 48 preset voices, support for multiple languages, and voice cloning from a short recording.

KittenTTS 0.8 is a smaller, faster option featuring Nano, Micro, and Mini models, 8 preset voices, and speed control.

Models can be downloaded directly inside the app from the Models tab.

apps.localizedDescription: Play Command and Conquer Generals: Zero Hour natively on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Silicon Macs. Enjoy campaign, skirmish, and Generals Challenge modes with touch controls built for real-time strategy, including tap-select, drag-box, long-press deselect, two-finger scroll, and pinch zoom. apps.subtitle: Create static and animated WhatsApp stickers quickly
apps.localizedDescription: Stickreate is a native iPhone app designed to create static and animated WhatsApp stickers quickly with automatic background removal. The app handles tray icons and prevents mixing static and animated stickers in a single pack.

apps.name: MCX360 Edition
apps.subtitle: Minecraft Xbox 360 Edition port for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
MCX360 Edition is a native iOS port of Minecraft: Xbox 360 Edition Title Update 9, built using the ReXGlue static recompilation SDK. Xbox 360 code is recompiled ahead of time to run natively on iPhone, and graphics run through Vulkan on Metal via MoltenVK. Developer mode may be required on certain iOS versions.

You must provide your own copy of the game, including data files such as textures, sounds, worlds, and the original default.xex from a disc and title update you own. This project is not affiliated with Mojang, Microsoft, or 4J Studios.

versions.localizedDescription:

apps.localizedDescription: Muffin is a port of the Cemu Wii U emulator to iPhone and iPad running iOS 15 or later. It uses the original C++ engine, including a PowerPC interpreter, ARM64 recompiler, full Cafe OS HLE stack, and Cemu's native Metal renderer wrapped in a SwiftUI interface. The project is in progress; graphics appear for real titles but are not yet correct, and no game has been confirmed fully playable. The source provides a standard build for SideStore, AltStore, and LiveContainer, which re‑sign the app with the user's Apple ID at install. Users must supply their own game files; no copyrighted content is included.

apps.name: Edge Eloquent
apps.subtitle: Private iOS dictation powered by Google AI Edge LiteRT
apps.localizedDescription: Private iOS dictation powered by the official Google AI Edge LiteRT-LM runtime and compatible audio models from Hugging Face. Model artifacts are downloaded on demand and verified with SHA-256. Optional cloud text enhancement and web search are disabled by default. Audio never leaves the device.

versions.localizedDescription: Fixes the Qwen recording failure by rejecting LiteRT CompiledModel artifacts before they reach the LiteRT-LM Conversation API. Hugging Face imports now require an explicit LiteRT-LM runtime declaration; VibeVoice uses deterministic ASR decoding and is the 4 GB default.

Shows model download state and percentage immediately in both Hugging Face search results and the model library. Progress includes transferred bytes and speed, with throttled UI updates and protection against stale callbacks overwriting completion states.

apps.subtitle: Remote control Android from iPhone
apps.localizedDescription: Screen Remote is a mobile port of scrcpy that lets you control an Android device from an iPhone. It connects via ADB over Wi‑Fi, uses hardware decoding to reduce power and CPU usage, and optimizes gestures for unstable networks. The app can be launched from a URL scheme, pairs devices with a pairing code, provides on‑screen Android navigation buttons (Back, Home, Switch App), toggles the iOS keyboard to send keys, syncs clipboard contents between devices, manages ADB keys (generate, modify, import, export), and forwards audio from Android 11+ devices to the iPhone.

apps.name: Decantra
apps.subtitle: Procedural bottle-sorting puzzle game
apps.localizedDescription: Decantra is a bottle-sorting puzzle game with procedurally generated levels that never run out. Sort the colored liquids by pouring from one bottle to another until each bottle holds a single color. Pour by dragging one bottle onto another. You can only pour onto the same color or into an empty bottle. Black bottles, or sinks, accept liquid but cannot be picked up, requiring careful planning. A level is solved when every non-empty bottle contains exactly one color. Early levels ease you in, while later levels introduce more colors, varying bottle sizes, and multiple sinks.

Sora, also known as Sulfur, is a modular media player for iOS and macOS licensed under GPLv3.0.

- JavaScript-based module loader
- HLS and MP4 video format support
- Optional offline watching via user-installed modules
- AniList and Trakt tracking service integration
- Apple Keychain authentication token support

- Background playback and Picture-in-Picture support
- External player support including VLC, Infuse, Outplayer, nPlayer, SenPlayer, IINA, and TracyPlayer

Requires iOS/iPadOS 15.0+ or macOS 12.0+.

apps.name: Clip
apps.subtitle: Manage your clipboard history with ease.
apps.localizedDescription:
Clip is a simple clipboard manager for iOS. 

Unlike other clipboard managers, Clip can continue monitoring your clipboard while in the background. No longer do you need to remember to manually open or share to an app to save your clipboard; just copy and paste as you would normally do, and Clip will have your back.

In addition to background monitoring, Clip also has these features:

• Save text, URLs, and images copied to the clipboard.
• Copy, delete, or share any clippings saved to Clip.
• Customizable history limit.

Download Clip today, and never worry about losing your clipboard again!

versions.localizedDescription:
NEW

iPad Support
• Supports multiple windows

FIXED

Custom Keyboard
• Fixed invisible text in dark mode
• Fixed opaque background in dark mode
• Fixed opening keyboard settings

• Switches to using location services to run in background

This update adds a Custom Keyboard app extension for quick access to clippings when editing text.

To enable the keyboard, go to Settings > General > Keyboard > Keyboards > Add New Keyboard... and add "ClipBoard". Once added, make sure to then enable "Allow Full Access" for ClipBoard so it can access your clippings.

apps.name: Mini vMac
apps.subtitle: A miniature early Macintosh emulator.
apps.localizedDescription:
Features

• Emulates Mac Plus, Mac II or Mac 128K
• Full simulated keyboard (including all Mac keys)
• Full sound output
• Uses external keyboard if available
• Regulable emulation speed
• Easy(ish) to import/export disk images

Please check out the github README for usage instructions: https://github.com/zydeco/minivmac4ios

versions.localizedDescription:
# Mini vMac for iOS v2.6

* Added 512×384 variant of Mac II
* Requires iOS 13.4
    * Dropping 32-bit support (iOS 9) made the app smaller
* Prefer pixel-perfect scaling when display scaling filter is set to nearest
* Auto-hide iOS home indicator
* Partially fix some command-key shortcuts going to iOS instead of the emulated Mac (#45)
    * ⌘-w and most others will get passed to the emulated machine if it's running
    * ⌘-q and ⌘-h don't seem interceptable, the app doesn't receive any key events for them, but ⌘-q doesn't do anything (or maybe it does in some other configuration?), and ⌘-h will take you to the home screen
* visionOS support (only tested in simulator)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/zydeco/minivmac4ios/compare/v2.5...v2.6

# Mini vMac for iOS 2.5

* Update to Mini vMac 37.03 beta
* Fixed crash when deleting disk images on iPad
* Adds recently used disks to quick actions menu
* Removed custom presentation modes for disk and settings screens
* Doesn't show "The developer of this app needs to update it to work with this version of iOS" error when installing IPA on iOS 15

apps.versionDescription:
# Mini vMac for iOS v2.6

* Added 512×384 variant of Mac II
* Requires iOS 13.4
    * Dropping 32-bit support (iOS 9) made the app smaller
* Prefer pixel-perfect scaling when display scaling filter is set to nearest
* Auto-hide iOS home indicator
* Partially fix some command-key shortcuts going to iOS instead of the emulated Mac (#45)
    * ⌘-w and most others will get passed to the emulated machine if it's running
    * ⌘-q and ⌘-h don't seem interceptable, the app doesn't receive any key events for them, but ⌘-q doesn't do anything (or maybe it does in some other configuration?), and ⌘-h will take you to the home screen
* visionOS support (only tested in simulator)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/zydeco/minivmac4ios/compare/v2.5...v2.6

apps.localizedDescription:
USE THIS IF YOU DO NOT LIKE THE NEW ONE OR IF ITS NOT WORKING

I would highly recommend you use the new Spotify tweak as it has been updated to work on newer Spotify versions and is currently being updated. However this tweak may stop working in the near future as it is an old version.



Spotify++ contants a tweak that activates Premium. As well as a number of tweaks to customise the UI and improve the overall user experience.

Here are the following tweaks:

• Spotilife - Premium for free.

• Sposify - A Tweak to customize your Spotify App UI and expand functionalities.

• Volify - Adds a volume slider to Spotify.

• SpotifyAllowSetting - Allows you to access all of the settings in Spotify that are normally disabled when someone else is playing music from another device.

• SpotifyNoPodcasts - Hides Podcasts from from Home and Library

• SpotifyHighQuality - Enables 'Very High' Quality in Audio Quality settings

•TrueShuffle - Enables true random shuffling (Spotify prioritizes Songs you have listened to more often by default)

• Spoticentre - Centres the song/artist in now playing (Only working on some devices)



NOTE

The ‘Car’ setting has been replaced with the sposify tweak settings so unfortunatley you cannot change car settings - all good tho, nobody use that shi anyways, and when car view enables when u in the car, just click ‘turn off car view’ at the top right corner.


All tweaks are injected by myself, WuXu, and ensured to be working perfectly ;)

apps.name: Deltroid
apps.subtitle: Multi-emulator for your classic games on the go!
apps.localizedDescription:
Deltroid is an all-in-one emulator for iOS. Deltroid builds upon the strengths of its predecessor Delta while improving on it in a community supported fashion. 

Github Repository (https://github.com/lonkelle/Deltroid) 

FEATURES

Supported Game Systems
• Nintendo Entertainment System
• Super Nintendo Entertainment System
• Nintendo 64
• Game Boy (Color)
• Game Boy Advance
• Nintendo DS
• Nintendo DSi
• Sega Genesis
• And plenty more to come!

Controller Support
• Supports PS4, PS5, Xbox One S, Xbox Series X, and MFi game controllers.
• Supports bluetooth (and wired) keyboards, as well as the Apple Smart Keyboard.
• Completely customize button mappings on a per-system, per-controller basis.
• Map buttons to special “Quick Save”, “Quick Load,” and “Fast Forward” actions.

Save States
• Save and load save states for any game from the pause menu.
• Lock save states to prevent them from being accidentally overwritten.
• Automatically makes backup save states to ensure you never lose your progress.
• Support for “Quick Saves,” save states that can be quickly saved/loaded with a single button press (requires external controller).

Cheats
• Supports various types of cheat codes for each supported system:
• NES: Game Genie
• SNES: Game Genie, Pro Action Replay
• N64: GameShark
• GBC: Game Genie, GameShark
• GBA: Action Replay, Code Breaker, GameShark
• DS: Action Replay

Deltroid Sync
• Sync your games, game saves, save states, cheats, controller skins, and controller mappings between devices.
• View version histories of everything you sync and optionally restore them to earlier versions.
• Supports both Google Drive and Dropbox.

Custom Controller Skins
• Beautiful built-in controller skins for all systems.
• Import controller skins made by others, or even make your own to share with the world!

Hold Button
• Choose buttons for Delta to hold down on your behalf, freeing up your thumbs to press other buttons instead.
• Perfect for games that typically require one button be held down constantly (ex: run button in Mario games, or the A button in Mario Kart).

Fast Forward
• Speed through slower parts of games by running the game much faster than normal.
• Easily enable or disable from the pause menu, or optionally with a mapped button on an external controller.

3D/Haptic Touch
• Use 3D or Haptic Touch to “peek” at games, save states, and cheat codes.
• App icon shortcuts allow quick access to your most recently played games, or optionally customize the shortcuts to always include certain games.

Game Artwork
• Automatically displays appropriate box art for imported games.
• Change a game’s artwork to anything you want, or select from the built-in game artwork database.

Misc.
• Gyroscope support (WarioWare: Twisted! only)
• Microphone support (DS only)
• Support for delta:// URL scheme to jump directly into a specific game.

**Deltroid and Sidestore are in no way affiliated with Nintendo. The name "Nintendo" and all associated game console names are registered trademarks of Nintendo Co., Ltd.**

apps.subtitle: ARM-based TI-Nspire calculator.
apps.localizedDescription: Third-party multi-platform emulator of the ARM-based TI-Nspire calculators.

versions.localizedDescription:
# New year, new version: Firebird 1.6

**New features:**
* New dialog for creating Flash images, which is also available in the Mobile UI! (#262) 
* Running as 64bit application on Windows is supported now (#234)
* Polish translation is available now (#207)
* CX II (/-T/CAS) calculators can now be emulated (#165)! However, with the current dumping programs you will not get a complete bootrom and booting the OS will fail.

**Improvements:**
* Multiple files can be sent in the Mobile UI and by dropping them into the main window on desktop (#279)
 Reimplemented emulation speed control: Now it's more accurate, especially on Windows
* GitHub actions now performs automated builds for Android (armeabi-v7a and arm64-v8a in one APK), macOS and Windows (32bit and 64bit) on releases and pull requests (#283, #284, #285)
* The "installer" for OS 4.5.3.14 (and later?) works now. It requires [fastboot RAM](https://hackspire.org/index.php?title=Memory-mapped_I/O_ports_on_CX#90030000_-_Fastboot_RAM) to persist state across reboots, which is now implemented.
* More accurate emulation of the On button: It's now possible to enter Press-To-Test mode (#271)
* Faster saving and loading of snapshots (#231)
* More reliable USB file transfers
* The debugger console now includes entered commands in the log
* Support for PIE (position-independent executables) on x86_64. Previously, care needed to be taken that PIE was disabled, otherwise it would crash on start. (#211)
* Building the JIT is disabled automatically if the platform does not support it (#197)
* Firebird builds on FreeBSD now (#228, #248)

**Bugfixes:**
* File access on Android got fixed (#202 and its various duplicates)
* Fix placement of keypad buttons in the touchpad area (#41)
* Various fixes for the Mobile UI layout (#201)
* The kit configuration page in the Mobile UI no longer causes the keyboard to pop up by default (#257)
* Connecting with GDB on windows works now (#259, #260)
* Some shades of grey were not displayed properly when emulating pre-CX models (#270)
* Fix crash on AArch64/arm64 when executing certain instructions
* The keypad reacts to touch events in the desktop version as well now (#292, #293)
* Some places were no longer translated correctly after the introduction of language switching in 1.5
* Keys could get stuck on focus changes. Now they're all released when the keypad loses focus (#287)
* The Ctrl key now changes color when pressed
* Emulation speed no longer remains unlimited after a failed file transfer

_Repo for Arch, Debian, Fedora, Ubuntu and openSUSE: [via OBS](https://software.opensuse.org/download.html?project=home%3AVogtinator%3Afirebird-emu&package=firebird-emu&locale=en)._

There is work in progress to implement and improve support for running in the browser on Qt for WebAssembly (#294). A preview is available on https://nspire-emus.github.io/firebird/wasm/

NOTE: BundleIdentifier changed in this version and automatic updates have been disabled until manual install occurs.

# A heap of improvements: Firebird 1.5

**New features:**
* UI language can be switched
* The debugger has a command history, press Up and Down arrow keys
* On Android, the system file picker is used now, which fixes "Could not start the emulation" in many cases
* The color scheme follows the system now
* Improved performance of CX flash access by ignoring certain cache flush requests

**Improvements:**
* LCD can be resized freely now
* Performance improvements for the ARM and AArch64 JITs
* Supports macOS 10.15 Catalina
* The Android APK includes arm64-v8a now
* The Windows ZIP includes software OpenGL now, so should work on more systems

**Bugfixes:**
* Fix the external LCD sometimes being invisible
* Allows building with recent versions of the Android NDK with clang
* Does not crash on exit due to use of incompatible compile flags with GCC
* Android devices with a lower w/h ratio are marked as supported now
* firebird-send supports different implementations of netcat now
* GDB and remote debugger work after emulation autostart as well
* Moving the cursor over keypad buttons no longer clicks
* On Windows, the filename for snapshots can now include non-ASCII characters
* Fix crash on emulation start on certain x86-64 systems
* Fix freeze on exit on JIT builds for the iOS version

Note: Firebird Emu requires Qt 5.9 now.

_Repo for Arch, Debian, Fedora, Ubuntu and openSUSE: [via OBS](https://software.opensuse.org/download.html?project=home%3AVogtinator%3Afirebird-emu&package=firebird-emu&locale=en)._

apps.name: iNDS
apps.subtitle: Revival of the Nintendo DS emulator for iOS.
apps.localizedDescription:
iNDS is a derivation of the previous Nintendo DS emulator apps for iOS: nds4ios and Nitrogen. The iNDS Team release of iNDS is a fork of the original iNDS emulator by William Cobb. The iNDS Team aims to create a version that is driven by support from the community, adding trusted contributors to the team over time so that pull requests and issues do not sit untouched.

Currently, emulation is powered by the DeSmuME threaded ARM interpreter and runs at nearly full speed on the iPhone 5 and above. Due to the need to mmap the entire ROM into memory, older devices with only 256MB of RAM are not supported. These devices include the iPod Touch 4, iPad 1, iPhone 3GS, and anything below those devices.

apps.name: Angry Birds Space
apps.subtitle: Removed from the App Store!
apps.localizedDescription:
The #1 mobile game of all time blasts off into space!

Play over 300 interstellar levels across 10 planets – including our very own Solar System!

Whether it’s the icy orbs of Cold Cuts, the volcanic explosiveness of Red Planet, Utopia – a planet made entirely of junk food, or even our own Solar System, each episode offers intergalactic fun at every turn! And the low-gravity environment of space results in spectacular gameplay ranging from slow-motion puzzles to lightspeed destruction. With brand new birds, special abilities, and a whole galaxy to explore, the sky is no longer the limit!

-----

“Intergalactic phenomenon worth every penny” – AppCraver

“Takes the fundamental physics-based flinging of the original and turns it on its head... It's satisfying, yet completely familiar, and is heaps of pig-smashing fun.” – Gamespot

“Anyone burnt out on vanilla bird flinging will enjoy the game's out-of-this-world adventure.” -- IGN

-----

- Over 300 interstellar levels!
- New playable characters!
- Unique special abilities for each bird!
- Zero-gravity space adventures!
- Trick shots using planets’ gravity!
- Hidden bonus levels!
- Beautifully detailed backgrounds!
- Daily Missions!

-----

Join the global phenomenon as it goes galactic!

apps.name: Angry Birds Star Wars
apps.subtitle: Removed from the App Store!
apps.localizedDescription:
JOIN THE ANGRY BIRDS IN THEIR BIGGEST ADVENTURE YET!

A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away... a group of desperate rebel birds faced off against a galactic menace: the Empire’s evil Pigtroopers!

Rebel birds, striking from a hidden base, have won their first victory against the evil Imperial Pigs. During the battle, Rebel spies managed to steal secret plans to the Empire’s ultimate weapon, the PIG STAR, and are racing to deliver the plans to the Rebel Birds. Now they need your help!

Join an epic adventure with the Angry Birds in the legendary Star Wars™ universe! Use the Force, wield your lightsaber, and blast away Pigtroopers on an intergalactic journey from the deserts of Tatooine to the depths of the Pig Star -- where you’ll face off against the terrifying Darth Vader, Dark Lord of the Pigs! Can you become a Jedi Master and restore freedom to the galaxy?

Time to grab your lightsaber and join the adventure! May the birds be with you!

HOURS AND HOURS OF ENGAGING GAMEPLAY - Explore more than 100 levels in iconic locations like Tatooine and the Pig Star. Can you dodge Imperial pigs, laser turrets, Tusken Raider pigs, and the dark side of the Force to get all three stars?

NEW GAMEPLAY MECHANICS - Use lightsabers, Blasters and Jedi powers to wreak havoc on the Imperial Pigs!

LEVEL UP YOUR BIRDS - Keep playing and level up your birds to improve their skills!

SECRETS AND HIDDEN GOODIES - Can you unlock all the R2-D2 and C-3PO bonus levels?

FREE UPDATES - This is only the beginning of the epic saga!

THE MIGHTY FALCON
Stuck on a tricky level? Earn stars and call the Mighty Falcon to rain down the destruction. New goals, achievements and gameplay!

PATH OF THE JEDI
The ultimate training ground for a Young Jedi, this episode features 40 Dagobah Challenge Levels with Jedi Master Yoda! Master the Path of the Jedi to unlock the ultimate Lightsaber! Available as an in-app purchase, or by earning three stars on every level.

Follow @angrybirds on Twitter

Watch the videos, read the comics and submit fan art at angrybirds.com/starwars

Like us at facebook.com/angrybirds and say hello!

apps.subtitle: Bedrock Edition for tvOS (discontinued)
apps.localizedDescription: Minecraft: Apple TV Edition was the Bedrock Edition version for tvOS. Announced on October 27, 2016 and released on December 19, 2016 alongside the Fire TV Edition. The version was officially discontinued on September 24, 2018 and removed from the Apple App Store.
